en.md: ## 2.0 The disruption ladder

gemini.md: ## 2.0 中斷階梯

en.md: This chapter defines three disruption levels: **50% Degradation** (降載), **Global Cutoff**, and **Island Partition**. The three levels form an escalation ladder: each level includes every effect of the level below it.

gemini.md: 本章定義三個中斷梯級：**50% 降載**、**全球斷線**與**島內分割**。這三個梯級構成升級階梯：每個梯級都包含其下方梯級的所有影響。

en.md: Under 50% Degradation, the island loses approximately 50% of its foreign-routed bandwidth, the bandwidth that connects it to the global internet. Global Cutoff takes the conditions of 50% Degradation and removes the remaining foreign-routed bandwidth. Island Partition adds the loss of north–south connectivity inside Taiwan to that total global loss. The domestic network therefore operates normally at the first two levels, and Island Partition is the only level at which traffic between Taiwanese cities fails.

gemini.md: 在 50% 降載下，全島會失去約 50% 的境外路由頻寬（即連接全球網際網路的頻寬）。全球斷線則在 50% 降載的條件上，進一步剝奪剩餘的境外路由頻寬。島內分割則在該全球全斷的基礎上，再加上台灣內部南北連線的中斷。因此，國內網路在前兩個梯級均能正常運作，而島內分割是唯一會導致台灣各城市間流量失效的梯級。

en.md: The report anchors its analysis on 50% Degradation. Every trace of a shared dependency in Chapter 3 begins at that level and moves up through Global Cutoff to Island Partition.

gemini.md: 本報告以 50% 降載作為分析基礎。第 3 章對共同依賴的每一處檢視，均從該梯級出發，並依序向上推升至全球斷線與島內分割。

en.md: The table below shows the expected signal at each level on four observable measures: each column is one level, and each row is one measure. Some cells name a simulated scenario, a narrowed variant of one level, and the roster at the end of this section lists all ten. The evidence behind each cell is in §§2.1–2.3, under Recognition signatures.

gemini.md: 下表顯示四項可觀察指標在各梯級下的預期訊號：每欄代表一個梯級，每列代表一項指標。部分儲存格點出特定的模擬情境（即單一梯級的限縮變體），本節末尾的名冊列出了全部十個情境。各儲存格背後的證據見於 §§2.1–2.3 的「辨識特徵」小節。

en.md: The table uses routing terms from the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), the protocol that networks use to advertise routes to each other. A network cancels a route by sending a BGP WITHDRAW message. Each network is an autonomous system (AS), and the AS path of a route lists the networks that the route crosses. The control plane is the exchange of these routing messages, and the data plane is the forwarding of user traffic.

gemini.md: 本表使用邊界閘道協定（BGP）的路由術語，BGP 是各網路相互宣告路由所用的協定。網路若要撤回路由，會傳送 BGP WITHDRAW 訊息。每個網路都是一個自治系統（AS），而路由的 AS 路徑則列出該路由所經過的網路。控制平面負責交換這些路由訊息，資料平面則負責轉送使用者流量。

en.md:
| | 50% Degradation | Global Cutoff | Island Partition |
|---|---|---|---|
| BGP behavior | During the sustained plateau (the period in which capacity stays low), routers send no WITHDRAW messages: the control plane stays silent while the data plane degrades. At onset, Multi-Cable Loss adds a short spike of WITHDRAW messages before routes reconverge (settle) onto the surviving paths. | Three patterns lead to the same data-plane outcome. First, physical cable loss produces a cliff of WITHDRAW messages (a sudden mass withdrawal of routes). Second, under administrative allowlisting (passing only approved traffic), as in Iran in 2026, routes stay advertised but traffic falls to zero. Third, in a forwarding failure inside a carrier, as at Rogers in 2022, routes stay advertised but traffic falls to zero. | Routes inside each half of the island stay stable, while prefixes (blocks of addresses) in the other half are withdrawn or unreachable. AS paths shift toward a new upstream AS. |
| Traffic plane | Traffic is degraded but survives: round-trip time (RTT) is higher and packet loss is sustained, with no cliff (no sudden drop). The domestic network is intact. | A cliff: international traffic drops to near zero within minutes of onset, while domestic traffic is intact. | Traffic is normal inside each half, and zero between the halves and to the rest of the world. |
| DNS/cache behavior | The rate of SERVFAIL responses rises gradually as resolver RTT exceeds client timeouts. SERVFAIL is the code that a Domain Name System (DNS) resolver returns when it cannot complete a lookup. The cache hit rate may rise, and there is no immediate cliff. | When the cutoff is triggered through BGP, lookups for domains whose authoritative servers are outside Taiwan return SERVFAIL at once. Cached responses then expire in staggered waves, each when its time-to-live (TTL) runs out. Records served through content delivery networks (CDNs) expire after hours, and platform records after 2–3 days. Mail-exchanger (MX) and name-server (NS) records with a long TTL expire after up to 7 days. | Lookups succeed inside each half and fail between the halves. The cache gives a grace period, which shrinks until the TTLs expire. |
| Recovery path | The queue for cable repair ships and the engineering schedule govern recovery, which takes weeks to months per cable segment. | Recovery depends on the cause. For physical loss (All-Cable Loss), the queue for repair ships governs recovery, at weeks per segment. For an administrative order with cables intact (Administrative Cutoff), only a political reversal ends the cutoff, and no engineering schedule applies. Documented cases of this kind range from a shutdown of 7 days ([OONI, November 2019](https://ooni.org/post/2019-iran-internet-blackout/)) to one that April 2026 reporting described as still ongoing and record-breaking ([Al Jazeera, April 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/5/frustration-grows-as-irans-wartime-internet-shutdown-breaks-grim-record/)). §2.2 follows the later case further. | Recovery has two tracks: global restoration and repair of the domestic trunks. Where part of the cutoff is administrative, cable repair does not shorten that part. |

en.md: **How to read §§2.1–2.3.** Each of the three sections has six subsections, in this order. **Definition** defines the level and states what it inherits from the level below. **What the failure looks like** describes what an engineer observes. At the three levels in turn, the engineer observes a brownout (slow, lossy service), a hard edge (international traffic stops outright), and a split between north and south. **Course over time** follows the disruption through numbered Phases, from onset to the slow final recovery.

gemini.md: **如何閱讀 §§2.1–2.3。** 這三個小節各自包含六個子小節，順序如下。**定義**說明該梯級的定義，並述明其承襲自下方梯級的內容。**失效樣貌**描述工程師所觀察到的現象。在三個梯級中，工程師會依序觀察到降質（服務變慢且伴隨封包遺失）、硬性斷崖（國際流量完全中斷），以及南北分割。**時間歷程**則按編號階段追蹤中斷過程，從發生初期一直到緩慢的最終復原。

en.md: **Recognition signatures** is the chapter's main diagnostic content: it gives the telemetry (what the measurements show) for each row of the table above. The subsection also shows how to tell the level from the neighboring levels. Where one level has forms that fail by different mechanisms, it shows how to tell those forms apart.

gemini.md: **辨識特徵**是本章主要的診斷內容：它提供上表各列的遙測資料（即量測數據顯示的結果）。該小節亦說明如何將該梯級與相鄰梯級區分開來。當單一梯級包含以不同機制失效的型態時，該小節會說明如何區分這些型態。

en.md: **Simulated scenarios** gives each simulated scenario a block with four parts. The parts are what happens, the precedent, how to tell the simulated scenario from a named one at the same level, and a note for drills. **In Chapter 3** names, in one sentence, where Chapter 3 traces the shared dependencies of the level.

gemini.md: **模擬情境**為每個模擬情境提供包含四個部分的區塊。這四個部分分別為事件經過、前例、如何與同梯級指定情境區分，以及演練備註。**第 3 章對應內容**則用一句話指出第 3 章在何處追蹤該梯級的共同依賴。

en.md: Each block also grades how far its precedent applies to Taiwan. The grade follows the label **Applies to Taiwan:** in the precedent part of the block. The grade *directly* means that the same event could happen in Taiwan. The grade *partly* means that the mechanism applies, but the scale or the conditions differ. The grade *in mechanism only* means that no comparable event exists, so only the mechanism applies.

gemini.md: 每個區塊亦會評定其前例對台灣的適用程度。評級緊接於前例部分的 **對台灣的適用程度：** 標籤之後。評級 *直接適用* 代表相同事件可能發生於台灣。評級 *部分適用* 代表機制適用，但規模或條件不同。評級 *僅機制適用* 則代表無可比擬的事件存在，僅機制適用。

en.md: ## 2.1 50% Degradation
### Definition

gemini.md: ### 定義（Definition）

en.md: 50% Degradation is the first level of the escalation ladder. The whole island loses approximately 50% of its bandwidth to the global internet, and the domestic network stays intact. The domestic network means users, internet service providers (ISPs), the domestic internet exchange points (IXPs: TPIX, TWIX, STUIX), and services hosted in Taiwan. The report calls the network's behavior at this level brownout (slow, lossy service), and keeps the name 50% Degradation for the level itself.

gemini.md: 50% 降載是升級階梯的第一個梯級。全島失去約 50% 對全球網際網路的頻寬，而國內網路保持完整。國內網路包含使用者、網際網路服務提供者（ISP）、國內網際網路交換中心（IXP：TPIX、TWIX、STUIX），以及在台灣託管的服務。本報告將網路在此梯級的行為稱為「降質」（服務緩慢且伴隨封包遺失），並將「50% 降載」保留為該梯級本身的名稱。

en.md: No level lies below 50% Degradation, so 50% Degradation inherits no effects. Every effect in this section also occurs under Global Cutoff and Island Partition. The reverse does not hold. 50% Degradation includes neither the complete loss of international traffic that defines Global Cutoff nor the north–south domestic split that Island Partition adds.

gemini.md: 沒有任何梯級位於 50% 降載之下，因此 50% 降載不繼承任何影響。本節中的每一項影響也會發生在「全球斷線」與「島內分割」之下。反之則不成立。50% 降載既不包含定義「全球斷線」的國際流量完全喪失，也不包含「島內分割」所增加的南北國內分割。

en.md: ### What the failure looks like

gemini.md: ### 失效樣貌（What the failure looks like）

en.md: Under brownout, capacity is reduced rather than cut. Most connections still succeed, but slowly and with packet loss, and the slowest few fail outright. Only international paths are congested: the domestic network is intact, so traffic within Taiwan flows normally. This contrast between congested international paths and normal domestic traffic is itself a diagnostic sign.

gemini.md: 在降質狀態下，頻寬容量是被降低而非中斷。大多數連線仍能成功，但速度緩慢且伴隨封包遺失，極少數最慢的連線則會直接失敗。只有國際路徑會壅塞：國內網路保持完整，因此台灣內部的流量傳輸正常。這種國際路徑壅塞與國內流量正常之間的對比，本身就是一項診斷特徵。

en.md: Applications fail by timeout rather than by refusal. HTTP requests stall and either complete late or time out (HTTP 504, not 502 or 503). TCP sessions survive but run slowly, video pauses to buffer, text messages arrive minutes late, and voice calls drop intermittently.

gemini.md: 應用程式是因為逾時而非被拒絕連線而失敗。HTTP 請求會卡住，隨後延遲完成或逾時（傳回 HTTP 504，而非 502 或 503）。TCP 工作階段（session）雖能維持但執行緩慢，影片會暫停進行緩衝（buffering），文字簡訊會延遲數分鐘送達，語音通話則會斷斷續續中斷。

en.md: The timeout pattern separates 50% Degradation from Global Cutoff and from normal conditions. Under Global Cutoff, connection requests (TCP SYNs) get no reply, and connection attempts end at the operating system's hard timeout. Under normal conditions, requests complete promptly.

gemini.md: 這種逾時型態將 50% 降載與「全球斷線」及正常狀況區分開來。在「全球斷線」下，連線請求（TCP SYN）得不到任何回應，連線嘗試會在作業系統的硬性逾時處結束。在正常狀況下，請求則會迅速完成。

en.md: Services fail in order of their need for low latency and high throughput. Streaming video, voice and real-time synchronization fail first. Text messaging and other protocols that exchange short text and acknowledgements survive longest. Priority traffic, such as banking, government and hospital communications, can be protected on the remaining capacity. That protection requires a quality-of-service (QoS) policy, a set of rules that gives chosen traffic priority.

gemini.md: 服務失敗的順序取決於其對低延遲與高傳輸量的需求程度。串流影片、語音與即時同步會最先失敗。文字簡訊以及其他交換短文字與確認回應（acknowledgement）的協定則能維持最久。優先流量（例如銀行、政府與醫院的通訊）可以在剩餘的頻寬容量上獲得保護。這項保護需要服務品質（QoS）策略，即一套給予指定流量優先權的規則。

en.md: The Matsu 2023 event followed this order. Both of Matsu's cables were cut, reducing capacity by approximately 75%, to roughly 25% of normal throughput. A text message could take 15 to 20 minutes to send, voice calls dropped intermittently, and Netflix and Instagram became unwatchable. Chunghwa Telecom reserved its microwave backup mainly for telephone, national-security, government, aviation and banking circuits, and gave government agencies, military units and hospitals preferential bandwidth. The Ministry of Digital Affairs (MODA) offered additional frequency bands to expand the relay ([Taipei Times, February 10, 2023](https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/taiwan/archives/2023/02/10/2003794094); [Taipei Times, February 17, 2023](https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/taiwan/archives/2023/02/17/2003794526); [Central News Agency via TechNews, February 16, 2023](https://technews.tw/2023/02/16/tw-matsu-cable-cht/); [The Wire China, June 2023](https://www.thewirechina.com/2023/06/11/cable-cutters-matsu-taiwan-china-undersea-internet-cables/); [The Diplomat, April 2023](https://thediplomat.com/2023/04/after-chinese-vessels-cut-matsu-internet-cables-taiwan-shows-its-communications-resilience/)).

gemini.md: 2023 年馬祖事件即遵循此一順序。馬祖的兩條海纜均遭全斷，導致容量減少約 75%，降至正常傳輸量的約 25%。發送一則文字簡訊可能需要 15 到 20 分鐘，語音通話斷斷續續中斷，Netflix 與 Instagram 則無法觀看。中華電信將其微波備援主要保留給電話、國安、政府、航空與銀行電路，並給予政府機關、國軍單位與醫院優先頻寬。數位發展部（MODA）則提供額外頻段以擴充轉接量能（[Taipei Times, February 10, 2023](https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/taiwan/archives/2023/02/10/2003794094)；[Taipei Times, February 17, 2023](https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/taiwan/archives/2023/02/17/2003794526)；[Central News Agency via TechNews, February 16, 2023](https://technews.tw/2023/02/16/tw-matsu-cable-cht/)；[The Wire China, June 2023](https://www.thewirechina.com/2023/06/11/cable-cutters-matsu-taiwan-china-undersea-internet-cables/)；[The Diplomat, April 2023](https://thediplomat.com/2023/04/after-chinese-vessels-cut-matsu-internet-cables-taiwan-shows-its-communications-resilience/)）。

en.md: When first switched on, the microwave backup provided 2.2 Gbps, against a normal cable capacity of 8–9 Gbps ([MODA press release, February 17, 2025](https://moda.gov.tw/en/press/press-releases/15210); [Domino Theory, Taiwan Internet Cable Problems](https://dominotheory.com/taiwans-internet-cable-problems-run-deep/)). The backup therefore started at about a quarter of the normal cable capacity.

en.md: ### Course over time

gemini.md: ### 時間歷程（Course over time）

en.md: A cable cut reduces international bandwidth within seconds to minutes of the physical break, so onset is fast. Under Multi-Cable Loss, a temporary reconvergence follows: routers settle on the surviving paths, using the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP). BGP is the protocol that networks use to announce routes to each other. Measurements of inter-domain routing have found that this reconvergence can take up to tens of minutes, with intermittent loss and high latency until it completes ([Labovitz et al., ACM SIGCOMM, 2000](https://doi.org/10.1145/347059.347428)).

gemini.md: 實體斷纜發生後，國際頻寬會在數秒至數分鐘內降低，因此發生速度極快。在「多纜中斷」之下，隨後會發生暫時性的重新收斂：路由器會利用邊界閘道協定（BGP）穩定在剩餘的路徑上。BGP 是網路之間用來彼此宣告路由的協定。對跨域路由的量測研究發現，這種重新收斂最多可能耗時數十分鐘，在完成之前會伴隨斷斷續續的封包遺失與高延遲（[Labovitz et al., ACM SIGCOMM, 2000](https://doi.org/10.1145/347059.347428)）。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Matsu 2023 capacity ratio of approximately 25% of normal and the application-failure-order pattern documented under What the failure looks like above)* In the first phase after onset, demand from the whole island fills the surviving international bandwidth at once, and the failure order begins. Streaming and voice fail as each user's throughput falls below encoding and jitter thresholds. Priority allocation, if used, takes effect within the same phase.

gemini.md: *（依據 2023 年馬祖容量約為正常狀況 25% 的比例，以及上方「失效樣貌」中所記錄的應用程式失敗順序模式所做的結構性推論）* 在發生後的第一階段，全島的需求會瞬間填滿剩餘的國際頻寬，失效順序隨之展開。當每位使用者的傳輸量降至編碼與抖動門檻以下時，串流與語音即告失效。若採用優先權分配，也會在此階段內生效。

en.md: Capacity then stays low, on a plateau, until the cause is removed. In the Matsu 2023 event the plateau lasted 51 days, more than seven weeks. The plateau ran from the second cable cut, on approximately February 8, 2023, to the first partial restoration, on March 31, 2023. Microwave capacity grew in steps: to 3.8 Gbps by March 6, 2023, to the capacity of the cables by the end of 2023, and to 12.6 Gbps by January 2025. The last figure is above the weekday peak demand of 9.5 Gbps ([Taipei Times, March 8, 2023](https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/taiwan/archives/2023/03/08/2003795708); [MODA press release, February 17, 2025](https://moda.gov.tw/en/press/press-releases/15210)).

gemini.md: 容量隨後會維持在低點的高原期，直到原因排除為止。在 2023 年馬祖事件中，高原期持續了 51 天（超過七週）。高原期自 2023 年 2 月 8 日左右第二條海纜中斷開始，持續至 2023 年 3 月 31 日首次部分復原。微波容量分階段成長：至 2023 年 3 月 6 日增加到 3.8 Gbps，至 2023 年底達到海纜容量，並於 2025 年 1 月達到 12.6 Gbps。最後這個數字高於平日尖峰需求的 9.5 Gbps（[Taipei Times, March 8, 2023](https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/taiwan/archives/2023/03/08/2003795708)；[MODA press release, February 17, 2025](https://moda.gov.tw/en/press/press-releases/15210)）。

en.md: When cables are physically damaged, the queue for repair ships sets the length of the plateau. *(Structural inference from TeleGeography cable repair fleet size data)* The global fleet has approximately 60 vessels, and fewer than 20 of them are dedicated solely to repair. The fleet handles approximately 150–200 cable faults a year. A simultaneous multi-cable event in Taiwan therefore joins a queue shared with every other cable in the world ([Scientific American, citing TeleGeography fleet data](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/iran-threats-expose-the-aging-fleet-that-repairs-undersea-internet-cables/)). Access restrictions can add months beyond the technical minimum. In the Red Sea in 2024, repair vessels needed permits, negotiated with Houthi-faction and Yemeni government actors, before they could enter the repair zone ([GeoCables, 2024](https://geocables.com/research/red-sea-cable-cuts-2024); [Marine Insight, Yemen political delay, 2024](https://www.marineinsight.com/shipping-news/yemens-political-disputes-delay-full-repairs-of-3-submarine-internet-cables-in-the-red-sea/)). Damage to cables on Taiwan's eastern seabed, in contested waters, could meet the same delay. A Gateway Throttle or Compromised Transit plateau involves no physical damage, so the repair queue does not limit it.

gemini.md: 當海纜遭受實體損壞時，修纜船佇列會決定高原期的長短。*（依據 TeleGeography 海纜維修船隊規模資料所做的結構性推論）* 全球船隊約有 60 艘船，其中專門用於維修的不到 20 艘。船隊每年處理約 150 至 200 起海纜故障。因此，台灣若發生同時多纜中斷事件，將進入與全球其他所有海纜共用的佇列（[Scientific American, citing TeleGeography fleet data](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/iran-threats-expose-the-aging-fleet-that-repairs-undersea-internet-cables/)）。存取限制更可能在技術所需的最短時間之外增加數個月。在 2024 年的紅海事件中，維修船隻進入維修區前，必須先與胡塞派系及葉門政府人員進行談判以取得許可（[GeoCables, 2024](https://geocables.com/research/red-sea-cable-cuts-2024)；[Marine Insight, Yemen political delay, 2024](https://www.marineinsight.com/shipping-news/yemens-political-disputes-delay-full-repairs-of-3-submarine-internet-cables-in-the-red-sea/)）。台灣東部海底爭議水域的海纜損壞，也可能遭遇相同的延誤。而「閘道限速」或「轉接遭挾持」的高原期不涉及實體損壞，因此不受維修佇列限制。

en.md: ### Recognition signatures

gemini.md: ### 辨識特徵（Recognition signatures）

en.md: **BGP and routing plane.** *(Structural inference from RFC 4271 route-withdrawal mechanics and the level's definition as capacity-constrained rather than route-severing)* Routers send no WITHDRAW messages (BGP messages that tell neighboring routers a route is no longer available) during the brownout plateau. None is sent because the surviving routes stay in the routing table: the bottleneck is physical capacity, not reachability ([IETF RFC 4271, January 2006](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4271)). BGP update volume over the plateau stays flat, or rises slightly as links at the network edge go down and come back. The volume shows no spike of several standard deviations, the kind that marks the onset of Global Cutoff. Monitoring tools that watch only BGP therefore raise no alert.

gemini.md: **BGP 與路由平面。** *（依據 RFC 4271 路由撤回機制，以及該梯級被定義為容量受限而非路由中斷所做的結構性推論）* 在降質高原期期間，路由器不會傳送任何 WITHDRAW 訊息（告知相鄰路由器某條路由已不可用的 BGP 訊息）。之所以完全未傳送，是因為倖存的路由仍留在路由表中：瓶頸在於實體容量，而非可達性（[IETF RFC 4271, January 2006](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4271)）。在高原期內，BGP 更新量保持平緩，或隨著網路邊緣的連結中斷與復原而輕微上升。更新量不會出現高達數個標準差的尖峰（那是標誌著「全球斷線」發生的特徵）。因此，僅監測 BGP 的監控工具不會發出警報。

en.md: *(Structural inference from RFC 4271 route-withdrawal mechanics and the level's definition as capacity-constrained rather than route-severing)* The main sign of 50% Degradation is therefore a silent control plane (routing) together with a degraded data plane (traffic). The degraded data plane shows higher round-trip time (RTT), higher packet loss and lower throughput. This pairing separates 50% Degradation from Global Cutoff, where both planes signal disruption, and from normal conditions, where neither plane does.

gemini.md: *（依據 RFC 4271 路由撤回機制，以及該梯級被定義為容量受限而非路由中斷所做的結構性推論）* 因此，50% 降載的主要特徵是安靜的控制平面（路由）配上受降質的資料平面（流量）。受降質的資料平面表現出更高的往返時間（RTT）、更高的封包遺失率與更低的傳輸量。這種組合將 50% 降載與「全球斷線」（兩個平面皆發出中斷訊號）以及正常狀況（兩個平面皆未發出警報）區分開來。

en.md: No BGP event record was published for Matsu 2023. The Open Observatory of Network Interference (OONI) does not probe Taiwan's link to its outlying island of Matsu. The reason is OONI's focus: international censorship and accessibility, not the quality of inter-island cables. The active probing of Internet Outage Detection and Analysis (IODA) targets international reachability, not domestic cables within Taiwan ([OONI methodology, ooni.org/docs/methodology]; [IODA platform scope, ioda.inetintel.cc.gatech.edu]).

gemini.md: 2023 年馬祖事件並未公開任何 BGP 事件記錄。網路干測開放觀測站（OONI）並未探測台灣與離島馬祖之間的連結。原因在於 OONI 的關注焦點是國際網路審查與可達性，而非離島間海纜的品質。網際網路中斷偵測與分析系統（IODA）的主動探測目標是國際可達性，而非台灣內部的國內海纜（[OONI methodology, ooni.org/docs/methodology]；[IODA platform scope, ioda.inetintel.cc.gatech.edu]）。

en.md: **Traffic plane.** *(Structural inference from the level's capacity-constrained definition and the Matsu 2023 measured capacity ratio of approximately 25% of normal)* Cloudflare Radar shows traffic below normal for the whole degraded period: traffic slopes down, stays on a plateau, then slopes up. Cloudflare Radar does not show the near-vertical drop to near zero that marks the onset of Global Cutoff. IODA's active probes to the affected address space keep getting replies, with higher RTT and higher loss.

gemini.md: **流量平面。** *（依據該梯級容量受限的定義，以及 2023 年馬祖實測容量約為正常狀況 25% 所做的結構性推論）* Cloudflare Radar 顯示在整個降質期間，流量低於正常水準：流量下滑、維持在高原期，隨後上升。Cloudflare Radar 並未顯示標誌著「全球斷線」發生的近乎垂直驟降至接近零。IODA 對受影響位址空間發出的主動探測仍持續收到回應，但伴隨更高的 RTT 與更高的遺失率。

en.md: *(Structural inference from TCP congestion-window mechanics per RFC 5681 and the level's capacity-constrained definition)* Delivered throughput falls even below the share of capacity that survives, because of how TCP reacts to loss. Sustained packet loss makes TCP shrink its congestion window, the amount of data that a sender may have in transit. TCP shrinks the window in both slow start and congestion avoidance ([IETF RFC 5681, September 2009](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5681)).

gemini.md: *（依據 RFC 5681 的 TCP 壅塞視窗機制以及該梯級容量受限的定義所做的結構性推論）* 由於 TCP 對封包遺失的反應方式，實際交付的傳輸量甚至會低於倖存的頻寬容量比例。持續的封包遺失會迫使 TCP 縮減其壅塞視窗（即傳送方在傳輸中可持有的資料量）。無論在慢啟動（slow start）還是壅塞避免（congestion avoidance）階段，TCP 都會縮減該視窗（[IETF RFC 5681, September 2009](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5681)）。

en.md: **DNS and cache behavior.** *(Structural inference from RFC 1034 recursive-resolver timeout mechanics and the level's capacity-constrained definition)* Name resolution degrades gradually rather than all at once. The rate of SERVFAIL responses (the code a resolver returns when it cannot complete a lookup) rises as resolver RTT exceeds client timeouts. The rate of NXDOMAIN responses (the code for a name that does not exist) does not change, because authoritative servers stay reachable, if slowly. The cache hit rate may rise as clients retry local caches, and this rise partly hides the degradation. Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) stapling, in which a server attaches a recent proof that its certificate is valid, typically succeeds where staples were refreshed shortly before onset. Transport Layer Security (TLS) handshakes mostly complete, but slowly, and the slowest handshakes (the p99 tail) fail outright ([IETF RFC 1034, November 1987](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1034)).

gemini.md: **DNS 與快取行為。** *（依據 RFC 1034 遞迴解析器逾時機制以及該梯級容量受限的定義所做的結構性推論）* 名稱解析是逐漸降質而非一次性失效。當解析器的 RTT 超過用戶端逾時門檻時，SERVFAIL 回應（解析器無法完成查詢時傳回的代碼）的比率會上升。NXDOMAIN 回應（代表名稱不存在的代碼）的比率則不會改變，因為權威伺服器依然可達（儘管速度緩慢）。由於用戶端會重試本地快取，快取命中率可能會上升，而這種上升會部分掩蓋降質狀況。線上憑證狀態協定（OCSP）裝訂（即伺服器附上近期證明其憑證有效的機制），在發生前不久已更新裝訂的管道通常能成功傳輸。傳輸層安全性協定（TLS）交握大多能完成但速度緩慢，而最慢的交握（p99 離群值）則會直接失敗（[IETF RFC 1034, November 1987](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1034)）。

en.md: Controlled experiments by Moura et al. support this gradual pattern. With 50% packet loss at the authoritative servers, caching and retries still let almost all clients resolve names, at the cost of higher latency for the slowest lookups ([Moura et al., ACM IMC, 2018](https://doi.org/10.1145/3278532.3278534)).

gemini.md: Moura 等人的對照實驗證實了這種漸進模式。在權威伺服器發生 50% 封包遺失的情況下，快取與重試仍能讓幾乎所有用戶端完成名稱解析，代價是極少數最慢的查詢延遲更高（[Moura et al., ACM IMC, 2018](https://doi.org/10.1145/3278532.3278534)）。

en.md: **Recovery path.** Recovery depends on the cause. Under Multi-Cable Loss, capacity returns step by step as each segment is repaired, at weeks per segment. Under Gateway Throttle, the cables stay intact throughout, and recovery is a policy decision with no engineering schedule. Under Compromised Transit, recovery requires a change in who controls routing upstream. Neither cable repair nor a policy reversal at Taiwan's gateways resolves Compromised Transit.

gemini.md: **復原路徑。** 復原方式取決於原因。在「多纜中斷」下，容量會隨著每個纜段完成修復而逐步恢復，每個纜段需耗時數週。在「閘道限速」下，海纜全程保持完好，復原屬於政策決定，沒有工程時程表。在「轉接遭挾持」下，復原需要改變上游路由的控制者。無論是修復海纜，還是在台灣的閘道撤銷政策，都無法解決「轉接遭挾持」。

en.md: **Telling the simulated scenarios apart.** Two routing signals separate the three simulated scenarios of this level: WITHDRAW messages at onset, and changes in the autonomous system (AS) path. The AS path is the list of networks that a route crosses, each identified by an AS number (ASN). Route collectors such as RIPE RIS and Routeviews, public services that store the BGP messages they receive from many networks, record both signals.

gemini.md: **區分各模擬情境。** 兩項路由訊號可用於區分本梯級的三個模擬情境：發生時的 WITHDRAW 訊息，以及自治系統（AS）路徑的變更。AS 路徑是路由所跨越的網路清單，每個網路皆由 AS 號碼（ASN）識別。像是 RIPE RIS 與 Routeviews 等路由收集器（儲存從眾多網路接收到的 BGP 訊息之公開服務）會記錄這兩項訊號。

en.md:
| | Multi-Cable Loss | Gateway Throttle | Compromised Transit |
|---|---|---|---|
| WITHDRAW at onset | A brief spike, then silence once routes settle on surviving paths | None: only traffic classification changes | None: coerced rerouting substitutes a new upstream AS without withdrawing routes |
| AS-path change | None: surviving routes keep their original peering relationships | None | Transit ASNs controlled by the adversary replace neutral carrier ASNs |

gemini.md:
| | 多纜中斷 | 閘道限速 | 轉接遭挾持 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 發生時的 WITHDRAW 訊息 | 短暫突發，隨後在路由穩定於倖存路徑上時恢復平靜 | 無：僅流量分類發生變更 | 無：脅迫式重導向會以新的上游 AS 取代，而不會撤回路由 |
| AS 路徑變更 | 無：倖存的路由維持其原有的對等互連關係 | 無 | 由敵對者控制的轉接 ASN 取代中立電信業者的 ASN |

en.md: ### Simulated scenarios

gemini.md: ### 模擬情境（Simulated scenarios）

en.md: #### Multi-Cable Loss

gemini.md: #### Multi-Cable Loss

en.md: A simulated scenario under 50% Degradation: one physical event cuts several international cable systems at once. The surviving cables carry the load in brownout. The global queue for repair ships lengthens restoration far beyond the time needed to repair one segment.

gemini.md: 50% 降載下的一個模擬情境：單一實體事件同時切斷數條國際海纜系統。倖存的海纜在降質狀況下承載流量。全球修纜船佇列使復原時間遠遠超出修復單一纜段所需的時間。

en.md: **What happens.** An earthquake, a submarine landslide or coordinated damage cuts several cable systems in quick succession. The surviving cables carry the rerouted traffic at lower total bandwidth, and every user who shares the remaining capacity experiences brownout.

gemini.md: **事件經過。** 地震、海底山崩或協同破壞在短時間內接連切斷數個海纜系統。倖存的海纜以較低的全總頻寬承載重導向的流量，共享剩餘容量的每位使用者都會經歷降質。

en.md: Landing-station loss with partial reroute is a variant of this simulated scenario. Physical damage takes one or more cable landing stations (the sites where submarine cables come ashore) out of service while the others keep operating. The cables at the surviving stations take over the lost traffic. The depth of the brownout is proportional to the share of traffic that had passed through the damaged station.

gemini.md: 登陸站中斷伴隨部分重導向是此模擬情境的一種變體。實體損壞使一或多個海纜登陸站（海纜上岸的設施）停止運作，而其他登陸站則維持運作。倖存登陸站的海纜會接管失去的流量。降質的嚴重程度與原先通過受損登陸站的流量比例成正比。

en.md: **Precedent.** The Hengchun earthquake of December 26, 2006 consisted of two shocks, of M7.0 and M6.9, off southern Taiwan. The shocks set off submarine landslides that cut eight cable systems: APCN, APCN-2, C2C, China-US CN, EAC, FLAG FEA, FNAL/RNAL, and SMW3. Repair took 11 ships and 49 days, or seven weeks ([Submarine Networks, December 2006](https://www.submarinenetworks.com/en/nv/news/cables-cut-after-taiwan-earthquake-2006)).

gemini.md: **前例。** 2006 年 12 月 26 日的恆春地震包含台灣南部外海兩次分別為芮氏規模 7.0 與 6.9 的強震。地震引發海底山崩，切斷了八個海纜系統：APCN、APCN-2、C2C、China-US CN、EAC、FLAG FEA、FNAL/RNAL 以及 SMW3。修復共動用了 11 艘船隻與 49 天（即七週）（[Submarine Networks, December 2006](https://www.submarinenetworks.com/en/nv/news/cables-cut-after-taiwan-earthquake-2006)）。

en.md: At the end of 2025, earthquake damage off eastern Taiwan disrupted six international cables: SJC2, PLCN, EAC1, FNAL, RNAL, and EAC2. MODA reported that all operators had finished rerouting traffic, and described external communication as stable, with possible slight delays at peak hours ([MODA press release, December 2025](https://moda.gov.tw/en/press/press-releases/18412); [MODA press release, April 2026](https://moda.gov.tw/en/press/press-releases/19392)).

gemini.md: 2025 年底，台灣東部外海的地震損壞導致六條國際海纜中斷：SJC2、PLCN、EAC1、FNAL、RNAL 與 EAC2。數位發展部（MODA）報告所有業者均已完成流量重導向，並說明對外通訊穩定，尖峰時段可能會有微幅延遲（[MODA press release, December 2025](https://moda.gov.tw/en/press/press-releases/18412)；[MODA press release, April 2026](https://moda.gov.tw/en/press/press-releases/19392)）。

en.md: **Applies to Taiwan:** directly. Hengchun shows worst-case simultaneous damage on the main island. The end-2025 response shows MODA's rerouting working on today's cables in a multi-cable event.

gemini.md: **對台灣的適用程度：**直接適用。恆春地震展示了本島遭受同時損壞的最壞情況。2025 年底的應對則顯示數位發展部（MODA）的重導向機制能在多纜中斷事件中於現有海纜上有效運作。

en.md: **How to tell it from Gateway Throttle.** Multi-Cable Loss shows BGP activity at onset: route collectors record a brief spike of WITHDRAW messages. Routers withdraw the routes through the cut cables, traffic reconverges onto surviving paths, and BGP is then silent. Gateway Throttle produces no BGP updates at any phase, because only the traffic-classification policy changes. That policy operates at the deep-packet-inspection (DPI) layer, where equipment classifies traffic by inspecting packet contents.

gemini.md: **如何與「閘道限速」區分。** 多纜中斷在發生時會出現 BGP 活動：路由收集器會記錄到短暫的 WITHDRAW 訊息突發。路由器會撤回通過中斷海纜的路由，流量重新收斂至倖存路徑，隨後 BGP 恢復平靜。「閘道限速」在任何階段都不會產生 BGP 更新，因為僅有流量分類策略發生改變。該策略運作於深層封包檢測（DPI）層，設備在此透過檢驗封包內容來分類流量。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise would test whether teams recognize brownout and tell it apart from the onset of Global Cutoff, given three inputs: a scripted log of BGP reconvergence, a ratio of surviving capacity based on the eight cable systems lost at Hengchun, and a repair timeline lengthened by permit delays.

gemini.md: **演練備註。** 桌上推演將測試團隊在給予三項輸入條件時，能否辨識出降質並將其與「全球斷線」的發生區分開來：一份預編的 BGP 重新收斂記錄檔、基於恆春地震損失八個海纜系統所算出的倖存容量比例，以及因許可延誤而延長的修復時程。

en.md: #### Gateway Throttle

gemini.md: #### Gateway Throttle

en.md: A simulated scenario under 50% Degradation: the cables are intact, but international gateways throttle (deliberately slow) general traffic on an administrative order (gateway failure kind k2, defined in §3.2.1). The slowdown is the same across all carriers, and it shows no sign of a cable fault or of route withdrawal.

gemini.md: 50% 降載下的一個模擬情境：海纜保持完好，但國際閘道依行政命令限制（故意減緩）一般流量（閘道失效類型 k2，定義於 §3.2.1）。所有電信業者的減速狀況均相同，且完全沒有海纜故障或路由撤回的跡象。

en.md: **What happens.** A government or carrier operator instructs gateway routers to cap general civilian traffic at a set throughput, using DPI to classify the traffic. Designated critical services, or services on an allowlist, keep their bandwidth. Users and applications cannot tell this brownout from the brownout that a cable loss causes.

gemini.md: **事件經過。** 政府或電信業者指示閘道路由器利用 DPI 對流量進行分類，並將一般平民流量限制在設定的傳輸量上限。指定關鍵服務或白名單上的服務則維持其頻寬。使用者與應用程式無法將此降質與海纜中斷所引起的降質區分開來。

en.md: **Precedent.** On March 10, 2021, Roskomnadzor, Russia's communications regulator, ordered Russian ISPs to throttle Twitter through TSPU DPI hardware. Censored Planet, probing actively from inside Russia, independently measured a ceiling of 130–150 kbps. The ceiling applied to 100% of mobile devices and 50% of fixed-line devices. The throttle lasted on mobile networks through at least May 2021. The peer-reviewed IMC 2021 paper calls the throttle "the first ever use of large-scale, targeted throttling for censorship purposes" ([Censored Planet / IMC 2021](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3487552.3487858); [Access Now tracker](https://www.accessnow.org/russia-throttled-twitter/)).

gemini.md: **前例。** 2021 年 3 月 10 日，俄羅斯通訊監管機構 Roskomnadzor 命令俄羅斯 ISP 透過 TSPU DPI 硬體限制 Twitter 的速度。Censored Planet 從俄羅斯內部進行主動探測，獨立測得 130–150 kbps 的傳輸上限。該上限適用於 100% 的行動裝置與 50% 的固網裝置。該限速持續至至少 2021 年 5 月。經同儕審查的 IMC 2021 論文稱該限速為「史上首次將大規模、針對性的限速用於審查目的」（[Censored Planet / IMC 2021](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3487552.3487858)；[Access Now tracker](https://www.accessnow.org/russia-throttled-twitter/)）。

en.md: **Applies to Taiwan:** partly. Taiwan has no sovereign-internet infrastructure and no hardware equivalent to TSPU in place. The mechanism would therefore need emergency regulatory authorization and DPI hardware at carrier level, which is standard equipment in major ISPs. Gateway Throttle is based on demonstrated technical feasibility, not on an institutional precedent from a regulatory environment like Taiwan's.

gemini.md: **對台灣的適用程度：**部分適用。台灣沒有主權網際網路基礎設施，也沒有部署類似 TSPU 的硬體。因此，該機制需要緊急法規授權以及電信業者層級的 DPI 硬體，而後者在大型 ISP 中屬於標準設備。「閘道限速」是基於已獲證實的技術可行性，而非基於類似台灣監管環境下的制度前例。

en.md: **How to tell it from Compromised Transit.** Gateway Throttle leaves the BGP AS path unchanged, because the throttle acts on traffic classification, which BGP route collectors cannot see. Under Compromised Transit, route collectors show a changed AS path on the affected international routes: transit ASNs controlled by the adversary replace neutral carrier ASNs.

gemini.md: **如何與「轉接遭挾持」區分。** 「閘道限速」會保持 BGP AS 路徑不變，因為限速作用於流量分類，而 BGP 路由收集器無法看到流量分類。在「轉接遭挾持」之下，路由收集器會在受影響的國際路徑上顯示已變更的 AS 路徑：由敵對者控制的轉接 ASN 取代了中立電信業者的 ASN。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise would test whether teams from carrier operations and product engineering, given traffic metrics filtered by DPI and no BGP alerts, recognize a brownout caused by gateway policy (gateway failure kind k2) and tell it apart from the onset of a cable loss without routing evidence.

gemini.md: **演練備註。** 桌上推演將測試來自電信維運與產品工程的團隊在給予經 DPI 過濾的流量指標且未收到 BGP 警報時，能否辨識出由閘道策略（閘道失效類型 k2）引起的降質，並在缺乏路由證據的情況下將其與海纜中斷的發生區分開來。

en.md: #### Compromised Transit

gemini.md: #### Compromised Transit

en.md: A simulated scenario under 50% Degradation: international capacity survives, but traffic is forced through upstream networks that the adversary controls (gateway failure kind k3, defined in §3.2.1, following the Kherson pattern). Measured by bandwidth, Compromised Transit looks like brownout, but what defines it is exposure to interception and lasting instability.

gemini.md: 50% 降載下的一個模擬情境：國際頻寬容量維持運作，但流量被強迫通過敵對者控制的上游網路（閘道失效類型 k3，定義於 §3.2.1，遵循赫爾松型態）。若以頻寬衡量，「轉接遭挾持」看起來像降質，但定義它的則是遭攔截風險與持久的不穩定性。

en.md: **What happens.** The adversary coerces gateway operators, physically or administratively, into routing international traffic through upstream ASNs that the adversary controls. Connectivity survives: traffic still reaches foreign destinations, and the BGP routes remain technically valid. All of that traffic, however, crosses the adversary's infrastructure, where it is exposed to content inspection, censorship and forced BGP path selection.

gemini.md: **事件經過。** 敵對者透過實體或行政手段脅迫閘道營運商，將國際流量導向由敵對者控制的上游 ASN。連線得以維持：流量仍可到達國外目的地，且 BGP 路由在技術上依然有效。然而，所有這些流量都會跨越敵對者的基礎設施，並在此暴露於內容檢驗、審查與強制 BGP 路徑選擇之中。

en.md: In Kherson, Ukraine, the instability took the form of a near-total outage on July 26, 2022. The outage came approximately two months after the first coerced routing change. The connection then remained unstable for more than a year ([Freedom House, Freedom on the Net 2022 Ukraine](https://freedomhouse.org/country/ukraine/freedom-net/2022)).

gemini.md: 在烏克蘭赫爾松，這種不穩定性表現為 2022 年 7 月 26 日接近完全的中斷。該次中斷發生在第一次脅迫路由變更約兩個月後。此後連線維持不穩定狀態超過一年（[Freedom House, Freedom on the Net 2022 Ukraine](https://freedomhouse.org/country/ukraine/freedom-net/2022)）。

en.md: **Precedent.** In May 2022, Russian occupying forces in Kherson, Ukraine, coerced local ISP staff into moving their BGP upstreams to Miranda-Media (AS201776) in Crimea and on to Rostelecom. A BGP upstream is the network that carries an ISP's traffic to the rest of the internet. The network owner said they "had no choice", and Kentik's BGP analysis confirms the AS-path change ([Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)).

gemini.md: **前例。** 2022 年 5 月，烏克蘭赫爾松的俄羅斯占領軍脅迫當地 ISP 員工將其 BGP 上游轉移至克里米亞的 Miranda-Media（AS201776），再轉至 Rostelecom。BGP 上游是將 ISP 的流量載送至網際網路其餘部分的網路。該網路擁有者表示他們「別無選擇」，且 Kentik 的 BGP 分析證實了 AS 路徑的變更（[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)）。

en.md: RIPE Labs measurements show that after the rerouting, latency to western networks rose and latency to Russian networks fell. Both latencies returned to their pre-occupation pattern immediately after liberation in November 2022 ([RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)).

gemini.md: RIPE Labs 的量測顯示，在路由重導向後，連往西方網路的延遲上升，而連往俄羅斯網路的延遲下降。在 2022 年 11 月光復後，這兩項延遲立即恢復到受占領前的型態（[RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)）。

en.md: **Applies to Taiwan:** partly. The route-capture technique works the same way as in Kherson and applies to any ISP whose physical gateway an adversary can reach. The geographic and political conditions differ.

gemini.md: **對台灣的適用程度：**部分適用。路由劫持技術的運作方式與赫爾松相同，適用於任何敵對者可觸及其實體閘道的 ISP。地理與政治條件則有所不同。

en.md: **How to tell it from Multi-Cable Loss.** Compromised Transit changes the BGP AS path. On the affected international routes, route collectors (RIPE RIS or Routeviews) show transit ASNs controlled by the adversary where neutral carrier ASNs used to appear. Under Multi-Cable Loss, the AS paths of surviving routes do not change. The surviving cables carry traffic through their original peering relationships, and the loss is of capacity, not of routing topology.

gemini.md: **如何與「多纜中斷」區分。** 「轉接遭挾持」會變更 BGP AS 路徑。在受影響的國際路徑上，路由收集器（RIPE RIS 或 Routeviews）會顯示由敵對者控制的轉接 ASN，取代原本出現的中立電信業者 ASN。在「多纜中斷」之下，倖存路由的 AS 路徑不會改變。倖存的海纜透過其原本的對等互連關係載送流量，損失的是頻寬容量，而非路由拓撲。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise would test whether an engineering team recognizes the exposure to interception under Compromised Transit and tells it apart from a brownout that only reduces capacity, given three inputs: AS paths from route collectors that show the adversary's transit ASNs, degraded throughput and content-accessibility metrics, and no sign of cable faults or BGP withdrawals.

gemini.md: **演練備註。** 桌上推演將測試工程團隊在給予三項輸入條件時，能否辨識出「轉接遭挾持」下的遭攔截風險，並將其與僅降低容量的降質區分開來：顯示敵對者轉接 ASN 的路由收集器 AS 路徑、降低的傳輸量與內容可達性指標，以及完全沒有海纜故障或 BGP 撤回的跡象。

en.md: ### In Chapter 3

gemini.md: ### 第 3 章對應內容（In Chapter 3）

en.md: Chapter 3 traces 50% Degradation, under each of the three simulated scenarios above, through the shared dependencies that carry its effects (submarine cables and landing stations in §3.1.1, satellite and microwave fallback paths in §3.1.2, and the concentrated international gateway in §3.2.1), and every §3.1 and §3.2 entry starts its 50% Degradation analysis from this section.

gemini.md: 第 3 章在上述三個模擬情境中的每一個情境下，追蹤 50% 降載穿過承載其影響的共同依賴（§3.1.1 中的海纜與登陸站、§3.1.2 中的衛星與微波備援路徑，以及 §3.2.1 中的集中式國際閘道），且 §3.1 與 §3.2 的每一個項目均從本節展開其 50% 降載分析。
