en.md: ## 2.2 Global Cutoff

gemini.md: ## 2.2 全球斷線

en.md: ### Definition

gemini.md: ### 定義（Definition）

en.md: In Global Cutoff, the island loses 100% of its bandwidth to the global internet, while the domestic network keeps working normally. The domestic network has three parts: the links between internet service providers (ISPs) on the island, the domestic internet exchange points (IXPs: TPIX, TWIX and STUIX), and locally hosted services. Global Cutoff completes the loss that 50% Degradation causes at half scale: bandwidth to the global internet falls to zero on every international cable.

gemini.md: 在全球斷線中，本島失去了連往全球網際網路 100% 的頻寬，而國內網路則維持正常運作。國內網路包含三個部分：島內網際網路服務提供者（ISP）之間的連結、國內網際網路交換中心（IXP：TPIX、TWIX 與 STUIX），以及國內託管的服務。全球斷線將 50% 降載在半數規模下造成的損失推至完全：所有國際海纜連往全球網際網路的頻寬均降至零。

en.md: Under Global Cutoff, a service works normally if its infrastructure is onshore and its dependencies use domestic routes. Any service with an offshore part or an offshore dependency becomes unreachable.

gemini.md: 在全球斷線下，若一項服務的基礎設施位於境內，且其依賴項均使用國內路徑，該服務便能正常運作。任何帶有境外部分或境外依賴項的服務，都會變得無法觸及。

en.md: Global Cutoff does not mean the domestic network fails, so the report does not call it a "total blackout". When the domestic network also fails, the event is Island Partition, not Global Cutoff.

gemini.md: 全球斷線並不意味著國內網路失效，因此本報告不稱之為「完全中斷」。當國內網路也失效時，該事件即屬於島內分割，而非全球斷線。

en.md: ### What the failure looks like

gemini.md: ### 失效樣貌（What the failure looks like）

en.md: Under Global Cutoff, the failure has a hard edge: international traffic stops instead of slowing. 50% Degradation produces a brownout, which is slow and lossy service: HTTP 504 gateway timeouts, higher packet loss, and congestion from Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) retransmission. Global Cutoff instead produces TCP connection timeouts for every destination outside Taiwan's domestic network.

gemini.md: 在全球斷線下，失效帶有硬性斷崖：國際流量直接停止，而非變慢。50% 降載會產生降質，亦即服務變慢且伴隨封包遺失：包含 HTTP 504 閘道逾時、更高的封包遺失率，以及因傳輸控制協定（TCP）重傳所導致的壅塞。相對地，全球斷線則會對台灣國內網路以外的所有目的地產生 TCP 連線逾時。

en.md: A single connection attempt shows the hard edge: the connection request (a TCP SYN packet) gets no reply. The attempt then ends at the operating system's TCP timeout, not with a slow acknowledgment. Domain Name System (DNS) lookups show the same edge. A query for a non-.tw name whose authoritative servers are off-island gets SERVFAIL, not a late answer. SERVFAIL is the response code a resolver returns when it cannot complete a lookup.

gemini.md: 單次連線嘗試即可顯現此硬性斷崖：連線請求（TCP SYN 封包）得不到任何回應。該嘗試隨後在作業系統的 TCP 逾時限制下結束，而非收到遲緩的確認回應。網域名稱系統（DNS）查詢也展現相同的斷崖。針對權威伺服器位於島外的非 .tw 網域名稱進行查詢時，會收到 SERVFAIL，而非延遲的回應。SERVFAIL 是解析器在無法完成查詢時所回傳的回應碼。

en.md: Two different mechanisms have produced this hard edge: an administrative order and physical destruction. Iran's administrative shutdown of November 2019 worked by withdrawing Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) routes at the gateway autonomous systems, while the cables stayed physically intact. The shutdown kept data-plane connectivity (the actual carrying of traffic) low from November 16 until November 21 ([OONI, November 2019](https://ooni.org/post/2019-iran-internet-blackout/)). Tonga's cable loss of January 2022 produced the same edge through physical destruction. Afterward, Cloudflare Radar recorded "close to no traffic at all" from Tonga's ISPs ([Cloudflare Blog, Tonga Internet Outage, 2022](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tonga-internet-outage/)). In both events, the domestic network and domestically hosted services kept working while every foreign-hosted service stopped.

gemini.md: 已有兩種不同的機制造成過這種硬性斷崖：行政命令與實體破壞。伊朗 2019 年 11 月的行政封鎖，是在海纜實體完好無損的情況下，透過在閘道自治系統撤回邊界閘道協定（BGP）路由來運作。該次封鎖自 11 月 16 日起至 11 月 21 日止，使資料平面連線（實際傳送流量的能力）持續維持低迷（[OONI, November 2019](https://ooni.org/post/2019-iran-internet-blackout/)）。東加 2022 年 1 月的海纜中斷則透過實體破壞產生了相同的斷崖。事後，Cloudflare Radar 記錄到來自東加各 ISP 的流量「幾乎歸零」（[Cloudflare Blog, Tonga Internet Outage, 2022](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tonga-internet-outage/)）。在這兩起事件中，國內網路與國內託管的服務均維持運作，而所有國外託管的服務則全部停止。

en.md: ### Course over time

gemini.md: ### 時間歷程（Course over time）

en.md: How fast a cutoff begins depends on the mechanism. An administrative shutdown has no brownout before it and, in network terms, begins at minute zero. This holds for both of its forms: gateway route withdrawal, and application-layer allowlisting, which passes only approved traffic. In Iran in 2019, cellular operators were disconnected first, at around 14:00 UTC on November 16, and almost all other providers followed over the next five hours ([OONI, November 2019](https://ooni.org/post/2019-iran-internet-blackout/)).

gemini.md: 斷網展開的速度取決於機制。行政封鎖在發生前不會有降質階段，就網路層面而言是在第零分鐘即刻開始。這適用於其兩種型態：閘道路由撤回，以及僅放行核准流量的應用層白名單放行。以 2019 年的伊朗為例，行動網路業者最早於 UTC 時間 11 月 16 日 14:00 左右被斷線，幾乎所有其他提供者則在隨後的五小時內陸續跟進（[OONI, November 2019](https://ooni.org/post/2019-iran-internet-blackout/)）。

en.md: A physical cable cut is fast but not instant. BGP withdrawals spread within minutes of link loss. In Tonga, Cloudflare Radar recorded near-zero traffic within 2.5 hours of the eruption's impact ([Cloudflare Blog, Tonga Internet Outage, 2022](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tonga-internet-outage/)).

gemini.md: 海纜實體斷裂的速度雖快，但非瞬間完成。BGP 撤回訊息會在路徑中斷後的數分鐘內擴散。在東加，Cloudflare Radar 在火山噴發衝擊發生後的 2.5 小時內，記錄到了接近零的流量（[Cloudflare Blog, Tonga Internet Outage, 2022](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tonga-internet-outage/)）。

en.md: Recovery also depends on the mechanism. After physical damage, recovery follows an engineering schedule: a repair ship must be sent, and the cable must be spliced and tested. Tonga, a country with a single cable, reconnected its main island after 38 days, more than five weeks ([Al Jazeera, February 2022](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/2/23/tonga-internet-reconnected-five-weeks-of-volcanic-eruption/)). An administrative cutoff has no such limit. Nothing is physically broken, so no repair ship can end it. Restoration is a political act.

gemini.md: 復原同樣取決於機制。在遭受實體損壞後，復原遵循工程時程表：必須派遣修纜船，並對海纜進行接續與測試。東加這個僅有一條海纜的國家，在經歷 38 天（超過五個星期）後才讓主島重新連線（[Al Jazeera, February 2022](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/2/23/tonga-internet-reconnected-five-weeks-of-volcanic-eruption/)）。行政斷網則無此類限制。由於實體上沒有任何東西損壞，因此沒有任何修纜船能將其終結。復原是一項政治行為。

en.md: Documented administrative cutoffs at the gateway range from Iran's seven-day, protest-linked shutdown of 2019 ([OONI, November 2019](https://ooni.org/post/2019-iran-internet-blackout/)) to a later Iranian shutdown. The report classes such cutoffs as gateway failure kind k1, defined in §3.2.1. Al Jazeera described the later shutdown on April 5, 2026 as already record-breaking while it was still in force ([Al Jazeera, April 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/5/frustration-grows-as-irans-wartime-internet-shutdown-breaks-grim-record/)). Cloudflare reported the same shutdown as partially restored in May 2026 ([Cloudflare Blog, Iran Internet Partially Restored, May 2026](https://blog.cloudflare.com/iran-internet-partially-restored-may-2026/)). *(Inference from OONI November 2019 and Al Jazeera April 2026 documented shutdown durations and Cloudflare May 2026 partial-restoration data; not independently confirmed)* Economic pressure played a part in both cases but did not reliably end either shutdown on any predictable schedule.

gemini.md: 在閘道端有紀錄的行政斷網，時間涵蓋從伊朗 2019 年與抗議相關的七天封鎖（[OONI, November 2019](https://ooni.org/post/2019-iran-internet-blackout/)），到伊朗後來的另一次封鎖。本報告將此類斷網歸類為 §3.2.1 所定義的閘道失效類型 k1。半島電視台（Al Jazeera）在 2026 年 4 月 5 日報導指出，該次較晚發生的封鎖在持續生效期間就已打破歷史紀錄（[Al Jazeera, April 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/5/frustration-grows-as-irans-wartime-internet-shutdown-breaks-grim-record/)）。Cloudflare 則在 2026 年 5 月報導該次封鎖已獲得部分復原（[Cloudflare Blog, Iran Internet Partially Restored, May 2026](https://blog.cloudflare.com/iran-internet-partially-restored-may-2026/)）。*（依據 OONI 2019 年 11 月與半島電視台 2026 年 4 月記載的封鎖持續時間，以及 Cloudflare 2026 年 5 月的部分復原資料所做的推論；未經獨立證實）* 經濟壓力在兩起事件中皆扮演了一定角色，但並未能依據任何可預測的時程可靠地終結任何一次封鎖。

en.md: If the cutoff lasts, whatever its mechanism, a second Phase follows: items that have an expiry time reach it, each on its own schedule. Cached DNS records lapse first, each at the end of its time-to-live (TTL), the period for which a resolver may keep the record. Short-TTL records lapse within hours of onset, and records served through content delivery networks (CDNs) within a day. Medium-TTL platform records lapse within two to three days, and mail-exchanger (MX) and name-server (NS) records within a week.

gemini.md: 若斷網持續下去，無論其機制為何，隨之而來的將是第二階段：帶有過期時間的項目將陸續到期，各自遵循其時程。快取的 DNS 紀錄最先失效，每筆紀錄均在其快取生存時間（TTL，即解析器可保留該紀錄的期限）結束時失效。短 TTL 紀錄會在斷網發生後的數小時內失效，透過內容傳遞網路（CDN）提供服務的紀錄則在一日內失效。中等 TTL 的平台紀錄會在兩至三日內失效，而郵件交換（MX）與名稱伺服器（NS）紀錄則會在一個星期內失效。

en.md: Certificates and signatures also expire in this second Phase. Certificate renewal through offshore Automatic Certificate Management Environment (ACME) endpoints stops at onset, but each certificate fails only when it expires, days to weeks later. DNS Security Extensions (DNSSEC) signature (RRSIG) records fail as their signing windows close. Protocol-Clock Cascade simulates this delayed wave of failures.

gemini.md: 憑證與簽章也會在第二階段到期。透過境外自動憑證管理環境（ACME）端點進行的憑證更新會在斷網發生時停止，但每張憑證僅會在數日到數週後實際到期時才失效。網域名稱系統安全擴充功能（DNSSEC）的簽章（RRSIG）紀錄則會隨著其簽章視窗關閉而失效。協定時鐘連鎖失效即模擬了這一波延遲出現的失效浪潮。

en.md: ### Recognition signatures

gemini.md: ### 辨識特徵（Recognition signatures）

en.md: Global Cutoff appears in traffic data as a cliff: international traffic drops suddenly to near zero while domestic traffic continues. The cliff rules out 50% Degradation, where traffic declines on a gradual slope. The continuing domestic traffic rules out Island Partition, under which domestic traffic between the two halves of the island also fails.

gemini.md: 全球斷線在流量資料中呈現為斷崖：國際流量突然暴跌至接近零，而國內流量則持續進行。此斷崖排除了流量呈平緩斜坡下降的 50% 降載。持續進行的國內流量則排除了島內分割，在島內分割下，本島兩半部之間的國內流量也會失效。

en.md: BGP feeds, the public streams of routing updates, are not enough alone to detect the cliff. Three mechanisms produce the same traffic collapse with different routing behavior, and under two of them BGP feeds show nothing:

gemini.md: 單靠 BGP 資料流（即路由更新的公開串流）不足以偵測出此斷崖。有三種機制會產生相同的流量崩潰，但伴隨不同的路由行為，且在其中兩種機制下，BGP 資料流不會顯示任何異常：

en.md:
| Mechanism | BGP feeds | Collapse visible in | Recovery path |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cable cut (physical damage) | Simultaneous WITHDRAW messages arrive within minutes of link loss. Monitors raise an alert, and routing-table observers and RIPE Atlas probes confirm the withdrawal. | Cloudflare Radar shows a step drop toward near zero. | Physical repair queue, limited by ship dispatch and engineering work |
| Allowlisting (administrative order) | Routes stay announced, so monitors raise no alert. | Only active probing (IODA) and traffic volume (Cloudflare Radar) show it. | Political reversal, in stages set by policy |
| Forwarding failure inside a carrier | Routes stay advertised, so monitors raise no alert. | Active probing shows it, with a response pattern different from allowlisting. | Restored in geographic batches |

gemini.md:
| 機制 | BGP 資料流 | 崩潰顯現於 | 復原路徑 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 海纜斷裂（實體損壞） | 連線中斷後數分鐘內同時收到 WITHDRAW 訊息。監控器發出警報，路由表觀察者與 RIPE Atlas 探針確認路由撤回。 | Cloudflare Radar 顯示向接近零階梯式下降。 | 實體修復佇列，受限於派船與工程作業 |
| 白名單放行（行政命令） | 路由維持公告狀態，因此監控器未發出警報。 | 僅主動探測（IODA）與流量（Cloudflare Radar）顯現異常。 | 政治轉向，按政策設定的階段進行 |
| 電信業者內部轉送失效 | 路由維持宣告狀態，因此監控器未發出警報。 | 主動探測顯現異常，且回應模式與白名單放行不同。 | 按地理區域分批復原 |

en.md: Administrative route withdrawal, as in Iran in 2019, shows the same signatures as the first row. It differs from a cable cut only in its recovery path, which is political reversal.

gemini.md: 如 2019 年伊朗的行政路由撤回，展現出與第一行相同的特徵。它與海纜斷裂的唯一不同之處在於復原路徑，後者屬於政治轉向。

en.md: Each row rests on a documented incident. The cable-cut row rests on Tonga, where the BGP update spike was recorded at 05:35 UTC on January 15, 2022 ([Cloudflare Blog, Tonga Internet Outage, 2022](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tonga-internet-outage/)).

gemini.md: 每一行均立足於有紀錄的事件。海纜斷裂行立足於東加事件，當地於 2022 年 1 月 15 日 05:35 UTC 記錄到 BGP 更新激增（[Cloudflare Blog, Tonga Internet Outage, 2022](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tonga-internet-outage/)）。

en.md: The allowlisting row rests on Iran's January 2026 shutdown. During that shutdown, 98.14% of Iranian IPv4 address space stayed globally routed throughout, yet human-generated traffic fell to well under 1% of previous levels ([arXiv preprint 2603.28753, 2026](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.28753v1); [Cloudflare Blog, Iran Internet Partially Restored, May 2026](https://blog.cloudflare.com/iran-internet-partially-restored-may-2026/)). IODA (Internet Outage Detection and Analysis), an active-probing platform, showed approximately 3% nominal responsiveness. That responsiveness represented allowlisted access for government entities. An engineer watching only BGP feeds therefore saw no event, while users experienced a full cutoff.

gemini.md: 白名單放行行立足於伊朗 2026 年 1 月的封鎖。在該次封鎖期間，伊朗 98.14% 的 IPv4 位址空間全程維持全球路由，然而由人類產生的流量卻降至先前水準的 1% 以下（[arXiv preprint 2603.28753, 2026](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.28753v1)；[Cloudflare Blog, Iran Internet Partially Restored, May 2026](https://blog.cloudflare.com/iran-internet-partially-restored-may-2026/)）。主動探測平台 IODA（Internet Outage Detection and Analysis）顯示約 3% 的名義回應率。該回應率代表政府機關獲得白名單放行存取。因此，僅監看 BGP 資料流的工程師看不出任何事件，而使用者卻經歷了完全斷網。

en.md: The forwarding-failure row rests on Rogers Canada's July 2022 outage. Approximately 240 IPv4 and 120 IPv6 routes stayed advertised in Rogers' routing table while traffic fell to near zero. They stayed advertised for more than eight hours. The failure lay in the internal forwarding plane (the part of the network that moves packets), not in the routing protocol ([Kentik, A Deeper Dive into the Rogers Outage, 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/a-deeper-dive-into-the-rogers-outage/)). BGP feeds miss a forwarding failure as they miss allowlisting, but the cause is a failure, not a policy.

gemini.md: 轉送失效行立足於加拿大 Rogers 2022 年 7 月的中斷。在流量降至接近零的同時，Rogers 的路由表中仍有大約 240 條 IPv4 與 120 條 IPv6 路由維持宣告狀態。這些路由維持宣告長達八個多小時。故障發生於內部轉送平面（網路中移動封包的部分），而非路由協定（[Kentik, A Deeper Dive into the Rogers Outage, 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/a-deeper-dive-into-the-rogers-outage/)）。BGP 資料流錯失轉送失效猶如錯失白名單放行，但前者原因在於故障而非政策。

en.md: DNS failures begin at onset and then increase. When BGP withdrawal causes the cutoff, SERVFAIL rises at once for domains whose authoritative servers are off-island. SERVFAIL can rise earlier when application-layer filtering comes before withdrawal. In Iran in 2019, OONI data show filtering leading withdrawal by approximately one hour.

gemini.md: DNS 失效自斷網發生時開始並隨後加劇。當 BGP 撤回導致斷網時，權威伺服器部位於島外的網域之 SERVFAIL 會立即上升。當應用層過濾早於撤回發生時，SERVFAIL 可能更早上升。在 2019 年的伊朗，OONI 資料顯示過濾比撤回早了大約一小時。

en.md: Meta's October 2021 outage (§3.3.1) documents the step from BGP to DNS. The prefixes that hosted Meta's DNS were withdrawn, and recursive resolvers at once returned SERVFAIL for its domains ([Cloudflare Blog, October 4, 2021](https://blog.cloudflare.com/october-2021-facebook-outage/)). Under Global Cutoff, cached records then lapse on the TTL schedule given in the Course over time subsection.

gemini.md: Meta 2021 年 10 月的中斷（§3.3.1）記錄了從 BGP 到 DNS 的演變過程。託管 Meta DNS 的前綴被撤回，遞迴解析器隨即為其網域回傳 SERVFAIL（[Cloudflare Blog, October 4, 2021](https://blog.cloudflare.com/october-2021-facebook-outage/)）。在全球斷線下，快取紀錄隨後會按照「時間歷程」小節給出的 TTL 時程相繼失效。

en.md: ### Simulated scenarios

gemini.md: ### 模擬情境（Simulated scenarios）

en.md: #### Administrative Cutoff

gemini.md: #### Administrative Cutoff

en.md: A simulated scenario under Global Cutoff: on government order, the gateway operator cuts international traffic to near zero, either by withdrawing routes or by application-layer allowlisting. This is gateway failure kind k1, defined in §3.2.1. The cables stay physically intact, and the domestic network keeps working normally.

gemini.md: 全球斷線下的一個模擬情境：依政府命令，閘道營運者透過撤回路由或應用層白名單放行，將國際流量削減至接近零。此即 §3.2.1 所定義的閘道失效類型 k1。海纜在實體上維持完好，國內網路則維持正常運作。

en.md: **What happens.** The simulated event begins when a government order reaches the autonomous systems that carry Taiwan's international gateway traffic. In the route-withdrawal form, as in Iran in 2019, routing-table monitors raise an alert within hours. Cellular operators withdraw before fixed-line operators, which leaves a staggered signature in public BGP feed data ([OONI, November 2019](https://ooni.org/post/2019-iran-internet-blackout/)). In the allowlisting form, as in Iran in 2026, routes stay globally announced, and only active-probing platforms and traffic-volume curves reveal the cutoff ([arXiv preprint 2603.28753, 2026](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.28753v1)).

gemini.md: **事件經過。** 當政府命令下達至承載台灣國際閘道流量的自治系統時，模擬事件隨即展開。在路由撤回型態中，如 2019 年伊朗，路由表監控器會在數小時內發出警報。行動網路業者早於固網業者撤回路由，在公開的 BGP 資料流中留下了交錯的特徵（[OONI, November 2019](https://ooni.org/post/2019-iran-internet-blackout/)）。在白名單放行型態中，如 2026 年伊朗，路由維持全球宣告狀態，僅有主動探測平台與流量曲線能揭示此斷網（[arXiv preprint 2603.28753, 2026](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.28753v1)）。

en.md: Both forms end the same way: international connectivity is near zero over undamaged cables. Onshore services with no foreign-routed dependency keep working, and every foreign address is unreachable. Politics and economics, not an engineering schedule, decide how long the cutoff lasts.

gemini.md: 兩種型態最終結果相同：在未受損的海纜上，國際連線接近於零。沒有國外路由依賴項的境內服務維持運作，而所有國外位址均無法觸及。決定斷網持續多久的是政治與經濟因素，而非工程時程表。

en.md: **Precedent.** Iran's November 2019 shutdown is the precedent for the route-withdrawal form. Orders went to two state-controlled gateway entities, TIC (AS49666) and IPM (AS6736). The orders took effect at every ISP without any ISP having to act. Traffic fell by approximately 95% within hours while the cables were intact, and domestic banking, messaging and mapping services stayed fully operational throughout ([OONI, November 2019](https://ooni.org/post/2019-iran-internet-blackout/); [Kentik, From Stealth Blackout to Whitelisting, 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/from-stealth-blackout-to-whitelisting-inside-the-iranian-shutdown/)).

gemini.md: **前例。** 伊朗 2019 年 11 月的封鎖是路由撤回型態的前例。命令下達至兩家國營閘道機構：TIC（AS49666）與 IPM（AS6736）。命令在每家 ISP 生效，無須任何 ISP 自行採取行動。在海纜完好無損的情況下，流量於數小時內暴跌約 95%，而國內的銀行、通訊與地圖服務則全程維持完全運作（[OONI, November 2019](https://ooni.org/post/2019-iran-internet-blackout/)；[Kentik, From Stealth Blackout to Whitelisting, 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/from-stealth-blackout-to-whitelisting-inside-the-iranian-shutdown/)）。

en.md: Iran's January 2026 shutdown is the precedent for the allowlisting form, at the same gateway infrastructure ([arXiv preprint 2603.28753, 2026](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.28753v1)). An earlier measurement study found the same split between routing-plane and data-plane shutdowns in 2011. Egypt's shutdown appeared in BGP data as the withdrawal of its prefixes, and Libya appears to have tested firewall-based blocking before moving to BGP-based disconnection ([Dainotti et al., ACM IMC, 2011](https://doi.org/10.1145/2068816.2068818)).

gemini.md: 伊朗 2026 年 1 月在相同閘道設施進行的封鎖，則是白名單放行型態的前例（[arXiv preprint 2603.28753, 2026](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.28753v1)）。一項早期的量測研究在 2011 年就發現了路由平面與資料平面封鎖之間的相同劃分。埃及的封鎖在 BGP 資料中呈現為前綴的撤回，而利比亞似乎在轉向基於 BGP 的斷線之前測試了基於防火牆的封鎖（[Dainotti et al., ACM IMC, 2011](https://doi.org/10.1145/2068816.2068818)）。

en.md: **Applies to Taiwan:** partly. The mechanism applies, but the legal and political conditions differ. Taiwan's international bandwidth is concentrated in two Chunghwa Telecom gateway networks, HiNet and TWGate (§3.2.1). This is the gateway concentration that a coordinated order would require.

gemini.md: **對台灣的適用程度：** 部分適用。機制本身適用，但法律與政治條件不同。台灣的國際頻寬集中於中華電信的兩個閘道網路：HiNet 與 TWGate（§3.2.1）。這正是協調命令所需具備的閘道集中度。

en.md: The political threshold is higher in Taiwan than under Iran's two-AS architecture. Taiwan has no sovereign-internet law and no standing authority for gateway route withdrawal comparable to the chain of orders from Iran's Ministry of ICT. An administrative shutdown would therefore require emergency legal powers over telecommunications and compliance by the carriers.

gemini.md: 比起伊朗的雙 AS 架構，台灣的政治門檻更高。台灣並無主權網際網路法律，也沒有類似伊朗資通訊科技部命令鏈那般用於閘道路由撤回的常設授權。因此，行政封鎖需要針對電信營運的緊急法律授權以及電信業者的配合。

en.md: **How to tell it from All-Cable Loss.** In its allowlisting form, Administrative Cutoff differs from All-Cable Loss in BGP. Traffic collapses to near zero, but there is no withdrawal for routing-table monitors to see. In its route-withdrawal form, Administrative Cutoff shows the same withdrawal cliff as All-Cable Loss. The two then differ only in recovery, which comes from policy reversal, not from a physical repair queue.

gemini.md: **如何與「全纜中斷」區分。** 在白名單放行型態下，行政斷網在 BGP 面向上與全纜中斷不同。流量暴跌至接近零，但沒有路由撤回供路由表監控器察覺。在路由撤回型態下，行政斷網展現出與全纜中斷相同的撤回斷崖。兩者隨後僅在復原上有所不同：前者的復原來自政策轉向，而非實體修復佇列。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise where a simulated gateway order collapses international traffic without BGP alerts would test whether teams detect it from active-probing dashboards, not routing-table monitors, and identify which services work on domestic routes alone.

gemini.md: **演練備註。** 若桌上推演情境為模擬的閘道命令在無 BGP 警報下使國際流量崩潰，將能測試團隊是否能從主動探測儀表板（而非路由表監控器）偵測出此事件，並識別哪些服務能單靠國內路徑運作。

en.md: #### All-Cable Loss

gemini.md: #### All-Cable Loss

en.md: A simulated scenario under Global Cutoff: physical damage severs every international submarine cable, leaving zero cable bandwidth to the global internet while the domestic network operates normally.

gemini.md: 全球斷線下的一個模擬情境：實體損壞切斷了所有國際海纜，導致連往全球網際網路的海纜頻寬歸零，而國內網路則正常運作。

en.md: **What happens.** The simulated event opens when Taiwan's international cables are cut, all at once or in a cascade. The cause is either coordinated physical damage or a submarine landslide like those the 2006 Hengchun earthquake set off (§2.1, Multi-Cable Loss). BGP withdrawals from the affected ASNs spread within minutes, and Cloudflare Radar records the cliff. Domestically hosted services keep working.

gemini.md: **事件經過。** 當台灣的國際海纜一次性或連鎖性遭切斷時，模擬事件隨即展開。原因可能為經過協調的實體破壞，或是類似 2006 年恆春地震所引發的海底山崩（§2.1「多纜中斷」）。來自受影響 ASN 的 BGP 撤回訊息會在數分鐘內擴散，Cloudflare Radar 則記錄到該斷崖。國內託管的服務維持運作。

notes: "The cause is either … or …" 譯為「原因可能為…或…」，語氣變弱。

en.md: In a variant of this simulated scenario, the damage also destroys cable landing stations (the sites where submarine cables come ashore). The terminal infrastructure must then be rebuilt before cable repair can be completed. This variant shows the same BGP and traffic signatures as a cable-only cut, but the repair queue alone no longer sets its recovery. Recovery lengthens from weeks to months or longer, depending on which stations are destroyed and how much must be rebuilt.

gemini.md: 在此模擬情境的變體中，損壞亦摧毀了海纜登陸站（海纜上岸的站點）。屆時必須先重建末端基礎設施，才能完成海纜修復。此變體展現出與僅有海纜斷裂相同的 BGP 與流量特徵，但單憑海纜修復佇列已不再能決定其復原。復原時間將從數週延長至數月或更久，具體取決於哪些登陸站遭摧毀以及需要重建多少設施。

en.md: **Precedent.** Tonga's January 2022 eruption, which cut the Tonga–Fiji cable, is the clearest available measurement of a country losing all of its cables. The subsections above give its onset signatures and the 38-day recovery of its main island ([Cloudflare Blog, Tonga Internet Outage, 2022](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tonga-internet-outage/); [Al Jazeera, February 2022](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/2/23/tonga-internet-reconnected-five-weeks-of-volcanic-eruption/)).

gemini.md: **前例。** 東加 2022 年 1 月切斷東加—斐濟海纜的火山噴發，是一個國家失去所有海纜的最清晰可用量測紀錄。上述小節給出了其發生特徵以及主島 38 天的復原歷程（[Cloudflare Blog, Tonga Internet Outage, 2022](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tonga-internet-outage/)；[Al Jazeera, February 2022](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/2/23/tonga-internet-reconnected-five-weeks-of-volcanic-eruption/)）。

en.md: **Applies to Taiwan:** partly. Tonga had a single cable, whereas Taiwan had 15 international submarine cables at the end of February 2026 ([MODA press release, April 2026](https://moda.gov.tw/en/press/press-releases/19392)), with over 300 Tbps of designed capacity ([Ketagalan Media, February 2025](https://ketagalanmedia.com/2025/02/23/taiwans-submarine-cable-network-strategic-value-and-future-outlook/)). The 2006 Hengchun earthquake severed eight systems, and the cables that survived still prevented a complete cutoff. A complete cutoff would therefore need physical damage on a larger scale than Hengchun, or coordinated damage to every active cable system.

gemini.md: **對台灣的適用程度：** 部分適用。東加僅有一條海纜，而截至 2026 年 2 月底，台灣擁有 15 條國際海纜（[MODA press release, April 2026](https://moda.gov.tw/en/press/press-releases/19392)），設計容量超過 300 Tbps（[Ketagalan Media, February 2025](https://ketagalanmedia.com/2025/02/23/taiwans-submarine-cable-network-strategic-value-and-future-outlook/)）。2006 年恆春地震切斷了八個系統，而倖存的海纜仍避免了完全斷線。因此，完全斷線需要比恆春地震更大規模的實體損壞，或是對每個運作中的海纜系統進行協調破壞。

en.md: After Taiwan's earthquakes at the end of 2025, MODA rerouting absorbed a multi-cable event (§2.1, Multi-Cable Loss; [MODA press release, December 2025](https://moda.gov.tw/en/press/press-releases/18412); [MODA press release, April 2026](https://moda.gov.tw/en/press/press-releases/19392)). Rerouting can therefore absorb a moderate multi-cable loss, and it becomes insufficient only at some larger scale.

gemini.md: 在台灣 2025 年底的地震發生後，數位發展部（MODA）的路由重送吸收了一次多纜中斷事件（§2.1「多纜中斷」；[MODA press release, December 2025](https://moda.gov.tw/en/press/press-releases/18412)；[MODA press release, April 2026](https://moda.gov.tw/en/press/press-releases/19392)）。因此，路由重送能吸收中等規模的多纜中斷，僅在更大規模時才會顯得不足。

en.md: **How to tell it from Administrative Cutoff.** Two features separate All-Cable Loss from Administrative Cutoff. Unlike the allowlisting form of Administrative Cutoff, All-Cable Loss always opens with a BGP withdrawal cliff that routing-table monitors detect. Unlike the route-withdrawal form, All-Cable Loss recovers only through a physical repair queue that no policy reversal can shorten.

gemini.md: **如何與「行政斷網」區分。** 有兩項特徵將全纜中斷與行政斷網區分開來。與行政斷網的白名單放行型態不同，全纜中斷總是伴隨著路由表監控器能察覺的 BGP 撤回斷崖展開。與路由撤回型態不同，全纜中斷僅能透過實體修復佇列復原，任何政策轉向都無法將其縮短。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise that shows the Cloudflare Radar and IODA signatures of a simultaneous multi-cable cut would test whether teams triage the incident from BGP withdrawal feeds and traffic-cliff data and identify which domestically hosted services stay reachable when physical repair timelines rule out any near-term restoration of international cables.

gemini.md: **演練備註。** 若桌上推演呈現同時發生的多纜中斷之 Cloudflare Radar 與 IODA 特徵，將能測試團隊是否能從 BGP 撤回資料流與流量斷崖資料對事件進行優先順序分級，並在實體修復時程排除短期內復原國際海纜的可能性時，識別哪些國內託管的服務仍保持可達。

en.md: #### Satellite Trickle

gemini.md: #### Satellite Trickle

en.md: A simulated scenario under Global Cutoff: cable bandwidth is gone, and the remaining satellite capacity carries only critical-service traffic. That capacity is a trickle (a very small flow) to ration, not a network restored to general use.

gemini.md: 全球斷線下的一個模擬情境：海纜頻寬消失，剩餘的衛星容量僅承載關鍵服務流量。該容量乃是用於配給的涓流（非常微小的流量），而非復原供一般使用的網路。

en.md: **What happens.** Satellite Trickle begins inside another event under Global Cutoff, most naturally All-Cable Loss, once the remaining satellite paths are the only international link. Priority allocation sends the trickle to emergency coordination, government communications and prioritized financial transactions. Chunghwa Telecom prioritized critical circuits in a similar way on Matsu's microwave backup during the 2023 cable loss (§2.1; [Taipei Times, February 10, 2023](https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/taiwan/archives/2023/02/10/2003794094/)). General civilian internet traffic does not pass at a usable speed, if it passes at all.

gemini.md: **事件經過。** 衛星涓流始於全球斷線下的另一個事件內部（最自然的情況為全纜中斷），一旦剩餘的衛星路徑成為唯一的國際連結即觸發。優先權分配將此涓流導向緊急協調、政府通訊與優先處置的金融交易。在 2023 年馬祖海纜中斷期間，中華電信亦以類似方式在馬祖的微波備援上對關鍵電路進行優先排序（§2.1；[Taipei Times, February 10, 2023](https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/taiwan/archives/2023/02/10/2003794094/)）。一般民用網際網路流量即使能通過，也無法以可用的速度傳輸。

en.md: Satellite capacity available over Taiwan is well under 0.1% of its cable bandwidth (§3.1.2). No measured figure for the share usable in a cutoff has been published.

gemini.md: 台灣上方可用的衛星容量遠低於其海纜頻寬的 0.1%（§3.1.2）。目前尚未公布任何關於斷網期間可用比例的實測數據。

en.md: One low-Earth-orbit (LEO) terminal delivers tens of Mbps. MODA reports average download speeds of up to 90 Mbps for the OneWeb service that its contingency network uses (§3.1.2). For Starlink, a different LEO system, crowdsourced measurements put most clients at about 50–100 Mbps download at the 75th percentile. The measurements cover 19.2 million speed tests from 34 countries since 2021 ([Mohan et al., ACM Web Conference, 2024](https://doi.org/10.1145/3589334.3645328)).

gemini.md: 一台低軌衛星（LEO）終端可提供數十 Mbps 的速率。數位發展部（MODA）報告指出，其應變網路所使用的 OneWeb 服務平均下載速度最高可達 90 Mbps（§3.1.2）。至於另一個 LEO 系統 Starlink，眾包量測顯示在第 75 百分位數上，大多數用戶端的下載速度約為 50–100 Mbps。該量測涵蓋自 2021 年以來來自 34 個國家的 1,920 萬次測速（[Mohan et al., ACM Web Conference, 2024](https://doi.org/10.1145/3589334.3645328)）。

en.md: Taiwan's published plans describe the same rationing. Chunghwa Telecom has said that if all of Taiwan's more than ten international cables are cut, high-, mid- and low-orbit satellites take over in layers. The National Communications Commission's (NCC) wartime plan, as reported, cuts public 4G/5G capacity to 1% of normal and carries voice and SMS only (劉致昕, 管婺媛 and 陳泳丞, 〈戰火下的新商業〉, *商業周刊* no. 2029, October 5, 2026, pp. 84–85). The same report quotes 林一平 (Lin Yi-Bing) of National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University warning of signalling overload (「信令過載」). The report also notes that under disaster roaming a base station sized for 200 people serves 300.

gemini.md: 台灣已公布的計畫亦描述了相同的配給方式。中華電信曾表示，若台灣十多條國際海纜全部切斷，高、中、低軌衛星將分層接手。據報導，國家通訊傳播委員會（NCC）的戰時計畫將大眾 4G/5G 容量削減至正常的 1%，且僅承載語音與簡訊（劉致昕、管婺媛與陳泳丞，〈戰火下的新商業〉，《商業周刊》第 2029 期，2026 年 10 月 5 日，頁 84–85）。同一份報導引述國立陽明交通大學林一平（Lin Yi-Bing）的警告，提醒注意信令過載（「信令過載」）。報導亦指出，在災難漫遊下，原容量為 200 人的基地台需服務 300 人。

en.md: Chunghwa Telecom also puts its prepared capacity at about 50–60 times (五、六十倍) what basic communication (「基本通訊」) needs (劉致昕, 管婺媛 and 陳泳丞, 〈戰火下的新商業〉, *商業周刊* no. 2029, October 5, 2026, p. 84). That multiple is measured against basic communication, not normal traffic, so it does not measure the usable share.

gemini.md: 中華電信亦將其準備的容量定為基本通訊（「基本通訊」）需求的五、六十倍（五、六十倍）（劉致昕、管婺媛與陳泳丞，〈戰火下的新商業〉，《商業周刊》第 2029 期，2026 年 10 月 5 日，頁 84）。該倍數是以基本通訊而非正常流量衡量，因此無法用來衡量可用的流量比例。

notes: 英文 "about 50–60 times" 的阿拉伯數字「50–60」遺失，括號內中文重複。

en.md: **Precedent.** After Tonga's cable was cut in January 2022, Cloudflare Radar recorded only "minimal Internet traffic via satellite services" from Tonga's ISPs. The signal, measurably above zero, came from individual satellite-terminal users, not from an activated national backup plan ([Cloudflare Blog, Tonga Internet Outage, 2022](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tonga-internet-outage/)).

gemini.md: **前例。** 2022 年 1 月東加海纜切斷後，Cloudflare Radar 僅記錄到來自東加各 ISP「經由衛星服務傳送的微量網際網路流量」。該訊號雖然可量測且高於零，但來自個別衛星終端使用者，而非來自已啟動的國家備援計畫（[Cloudflare Blog, Tonga Internet Outage, 2022](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tonga-internet-outage/)）。

en.md: Tonga signed a 15-year satellite connectivity agreement with Kacific in April 2019. The agreement had never been activated and was in arbitration in Singapore when the eruption cut the cable. Two days after the eruption, Kacific said it was still waiting for the government's instructions to activate the service ([ZDNet, January 17, 2022](https://www.zdnet.com/article/kacific-waiting-for-tongan-contract-activation-to-supply-satellite-services-post-eruption/)). *(Structural inference from the unactivated Kacific agreement)* A signed satellite contract is therefore not an operational backup until it is activated.

gemini.md: 東加於 2019 年 4 月與 Kacific 簽署了一份為期 15 年的衛星連線合約。在火山噴發切斷海纜時，該合約從未被啟動，且正在新加坡進行仲裁。火山噴發兩天後，Kacific 表示仍等待政府指示以啟動服務（[ZDNet, January 17, 2022](https://www.zdnet.com/article/kacific-waiting-for-tongan-contract-activation-to-supply-satellite-services-post-eruption/)）。*（依據未啟動的 Kacific 合約所做的結構性推論）* 因此，簽署的衛星合約在啟動之前並不屬於可維運的備援。

en.md: Ukraine's experience in 2022–24 supports calling satellite capacity a trickle rather than a network. Starlink's traffic share grew by over 1,600% from March to December 2022, and its daily users reached approximately 150,000 or more by January 2023. Yet Starlink never exceeded 0.3% of total Ukrainian internet traffic at any measured point. Its value lay in frontline and mission-critical uses, not in restoring traffic for the general population ([Cloudflare Blog, One Year of War in Ukraine, February 2023](https://blog.cloudflare.com/one-year-of-war-in-ukraine/)).

gemini.md: 烏克蘭在 2022–24 年的經驗，支持將衛星容量稱為涓流而非網路。Starlink 的流量市占率從 2022 年 3 月到 12 月成長了超過 1,600%，其每日使用者在 2023 年 1 月達到了約 150,000 人以上。然而，在任何量測時間點，Starlink 佔烏克蘭網際網路總流量的比重從未超過 0.3%。其價值在於前線與關鍵任務用途，而非為一般大眾復原流量（[Cloudflare Blog, One Year of War in Ukraine, February 2023](https://blog.cloudflare.com/one-year-of-war-in-ukraine/)）。

en.md: **Applies to Taiwan:** partly. Taiwan has no national satellite backup prepared in advance. LEO capacity over Taiwan is not sized as a national fallback at volumes close to normal cable volumes. Starlink is not lawfully available to civilian users onshore, although the July 2026 amendment removed the foreign-ownership barrier (§3.1.2; [Focus Taiwan, July 21, 2026](https://focustaiwan.tw/business/202607210011)).

gemini.md: **對台灣的適用程度：** 部分適用。台灣並未預先準備國家級衛星備援。台灣上空的 LEO 容量在規劃上，並無法作為傳輸量接近正常海纜傳輸量的國家級備援方案。雖然 2026 年 7 月的修法移除了外資持股限制，但 Starlink 法律上仍無法供境內民用使用者合法使用（§3.1.2；[Focus Taiwan, July 21, 2026](https://focustaiwan.tw/business/202607210011)）。

en.md: **How to tell it from All-Cable Loss.** Satellite Trickle leaves a small but nonzero signal in Cloudflare Radar and active-probing data. Within that small signal, priority traffic survives in a larger share than general consumer traffic. All-Cable Loss with no remaining path instead collapses to near zero and leaves only noise-level signals.

gemini.md: **如何與「全纜中斷」區分。** 衛星涓流在 Cloudflare Radar 與主動探測資料中留下了微小但非零的訊號。在此微小訊號中，優先流量的存活比例高於一般消費者流量。相對地，完全沒有剩餘路徑的全纜中斷則暴跌至接近零，僅留下雜訊水準的訊號。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise giving teams a simulated bandwidth budget in the trickle range would test how they rank traffic: which service types survive on severely limited international capacity, not how to restore full international connectivity.

gemini.md: **演練備註。** 若桌上推演給予團隊涓流範圍內的模擬頻寬預算，將能測試他們如何對流量進行排序：亦即在受限嚴重的國際容量下哪些服務類型能存活，而非如何復原完整的國際連線。

en.md: #### Protocol-Clock Cascade

gemini.md: #### Protocol-Clock Cascade

en.md: A simulated scenario under Global Cutoff: the cutoff lasts long enough for items with an expiry time to run out, producing a second, delayed wave of failures separate from those at onset. The items that expire include push tokens, refresh tokens, and software-license check-ins and similar check-ins. They also include Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificates, which can no longer be renewed because the ACME endpoints are offshore. DNSSEC signatures and Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) responses expire as well.

gemini.md: 全球斷線下的一個模擬情境：斷網持續的時間夠長，導致帶有過期時間的項目耗盡，進而引發與斷網發生時相獨立的第二波延遲失效浪潮。過期的項目包含推播權杖、更新權杖，以及軟體授權連線檢查與類似的連線檢查。它們亦包含傳輸層安全性協定（TLS）憑證，這些憑證因 ACME 端點位於境外而無法再更新。DNSSEC 簽章與線上憑證狀態協定（OCSP）回應亦會過期。

en.md: **What happens.** The simulated event begins once the first Phase of Global Cutoff has settled and the services that survived the loss of connectivity appear to work. A second wave of failures then arrives hours to weeks later. Because each protocol layer has its own expiry time, the wave builds up over days and weeks.

gemini.md: **事件經過。** 當全球斷線的第一階段安定下來、且在失去連線後存活的服務看似正常運作時，模擬事件隨即展開。第二波失效隨後於數小時至數週後到來。由於每個協定層都有其自身的過期時間，該浪潮會在數日與數週內逐漸累積。

en.md: Expiring certificates cannot renew, because the ACME endpoint is offshore. As RRSIG records reach the end of their signing windows, DNSSEC-validating resolvers return SERVFAIL for names that resolved before. OCSP staples (certificate-status responses that a server attaches) expire once a server's cached response passes the ten-day validity cap analyzed in §3.3.2 ([CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements 2.2.8, §4.9.9](https://cabforum.org/working-groups/server/baseline-requirements/documents/CA-Browser-Forum-TLS-BR-2.2.8.pdf)). After that, clients that enforce hard-fail OCSP checking reject certificates that are otherwise valid. Push tokens, software-license check-ins and refresh tokens expire at times set by each product.

gemini.md: 過期的憑證無法更新，因為 ACME 端點位於境外。隨著 RRSIG 紀錄到達其簽章視窗的終點，執行 DNSSEC 驗證的解析器會對先前能解析的名稱回傳 SERVFAIL。一旦伺服器快取的回應超過 §3.3.2 所分析的十天有效上限（[CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements 2.2.8, §4.9.9](https://cabforum.org/working-groups/server/baseline-requirements/documents/CA-Browser-Forum-TLS-BR-2.2.8.pdf)），OCSP 裝訂（伺服器附加的憑證狀態回應）即會到期。在此之後，實施硬性失敗 OCSP 檢查的用戶端會拒絕原本有效的憑證。推播權杖、軟體授權連線檢查與更新權杖則會在各產品設定的時間過期。

en.md: **Precedent.** [IETF RFC 8555, March 2019](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8555) specifies an ACME renewal model in which the client must reach a certificate authority (CA) endpoint to complete each renewal cycle. [IETF RFC 4034, March 2005](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4034) and [IETF RFC 4035, March 2005](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4035) specify RRSIG validity windows that expire unless the authoritative infrastructure re-signs the records.

gemini.md: **前例。** [IETF RFC 8555, March 2019](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8555) 規範了一種 ACME 更新模型，其中用戶端必須連至憑證機構（CA）端點以完成每個更新週期。[IETF RFC 4034, March 2005](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4034) 與 [IETF RFC 4035, March 2005](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4035) 則規範了 RRSIG 有效視窗，除非權威基礎設施重新簽署紀錄，否則該視窗將會到期。

en.md: The expiry of Let's Encrypt's DST Root CA X3 root on September 30, 2021, shows certificate-lifecycle failure under partial isolation (§3.3.2; [Let's Encrypt, DST Root CA X3 Expiration, September 2021](https://letsencrypt.org/docs/dst-root-ca-x3-expiration-september-2021/)). The IANIX DNSSEC outage list records signature failures across multiple incidents. One is the May 2026 key-rollover failure in the German .de top-level domain (TLD), which sent SERVFAIL to all DNSSEC-validating resolvers for millions of .de domains. The .de failure shows how one failed validation step spreads to every resolution path that crosses it ([IANIX DNSSEC outage list](https://ianix.com/pub/dnssec-outages.html)).

gemini.md: Let's Encrypt 的 DST Root CA X3 根憑證於 2021 年 9 月 30 日過期，顯示了部分隔離下的憑證生命週期失效（§3.3.2；[Let's Encrypt, DST Root CA X3 Expiration, September 2021](https://letsencrypt.org/docs/dst-root-ca-x3-expiration-september-2021/)）。IANIX DNSSEC 中斷清單記錄了跨多起事件的簽章失效。其中一起為 2026 年 5 月德國 .de 頂級網域（TLD）的密鑰輪轉故障，該故障導致數百萬個 .de 網域向所有執行 DNSSEC 驗證的解析器傳送 SERVFAIL。.de 的故障顯示了單一失敗的驗證步驟如何擴散至橫跨它的每一條解析路徑（[IANIX DNSSEC outage list](https://ianix.com/pub/dnssec-outages.html)）。

en.md: *(Structural inference from RFC 8555 ACME renewal model, RFC 4034 and RFC 4035 DNSSEC RRSIG validity windows, and the Let's Encrypt DST Root CA X3 expiry documentation cited above)* A sustained national cutoff would combine these expiry windows into a single delayed wave. No national-cutoff incident of this combined form is documented, so this simulated scenario rests on mechanism, not on an observed incident.

gemini.md: *（依據 RFC 8555 ACME 更新模型、RFC 4034 與 RFC 4035 DNSSEC RRSIG 有效視窗，以及上述引用的 Let's Encrypt DST Root CA X3 過期文件所做的結構性推論）* 持續的國家級斷網會將這些過期視窗結合成單一波延遲浪潮。目前尚無此種結合型態的國家級斷網事件紀錄，因此此模擬情境乃立足於機制而非觀察到的事件。

en.md: **Applies to Taiwan:** in mechanism only. The mechanism applies strongly. Taiwan's commercial services rely heavily on Let's Encrypt and other offshore ACME-issuing certificate authorities for TLS certificates. DNSSEC signing for commercial .tw domains crosses offshore authoritative infrastructure. Government domains under .gov.tw, by contrast, operate under the Government Root Certification Authority (GRCA, operated by DGBAS). GRCA is an onshore certificate authority that keeps working under Global Cutoff.

gemini.md: **對台灣的適用程度：** 僅機制適用。該機制適用性極強。台灣的商業服務高度仰賴 Let's Encrypt 及其他境外 ACME 發照憑證機構來取得 TLS 憑證。商業 .tw 網域的 DNSSEC 簽章需跨越境外權威基礎設施。相對地，.gov.tw 之下的政府網域運作於政府憑證總管理中心（DGBAS 營運的 GRCA）之下。GRCA 為境內憑證機構，全球斷線下仍持續運作。

en.md: **How to tell it from All-Cable Loss.** Protocol-Clock Cascade differs from All-Cable Loss in timing. All-Cable Loss fails at the moment the cables are cut, with TCP timeouts and immediate SERVFAIL for off-island names. Protocol-Clock Cascade fails days to weeks after onset, in a second wave after a period of stability. The second wave follows the schedule of certificate and DNSSEC expiry dates, not the moment of connectivity loss.

gemini.md: **如何與「全纜中斷」區分。** 協定時鐘連鎖失效在時間點上與全纜中斷不同。全纜中斷在海纜遭切斷的瞬間即失效，並伴隨 TCP 逾時以及島外名稱的立即 SERVFAIL。協定時鐘連鎖失效則在斷網發生後的數日至數週、經歷一段穩定沉寂期後的第二波中失效。第二波浪潮遵循憑證與 DNSSEC 到期日期的時程，而非失去連線的瞬間。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise that starts after the connectivity loss has stabilized and moves the exercise clock forward a few days at a time would test whether participants identify which protocol windows are expiring, which services are newly failing, and how each failure shows up, with no path back to international connectivity.

gemini.md: **演練備註。** 若桌上推演於連線中斷趨於穩定後開始，並每次將演練時鐘向前推進數日，將能測試參與者是否能在沒有復原國際連線途徑的情況下，識別哪些協定視窗正在到期、哪些服務新近失效，以及各項失效如何展現。

en.md: ### In Chapter 3

gemini.md: ### 第 3 章對應內容（In Chapter 3）

en.md: For each of the four simulated scenarios above, Chapter 3 examines the shared dependencies that decide which services survive Global Cutoff: the concentrated international gateway (§3.2.1), satellite and microwave fallback capacity (§3.1.2), the time-limited DNS and public key infrastructure (PKI) renewal chains (§3.3.1–§3.3.3), and application-layer systems with foreign-routed dependencies (§3.3).

gemini.md: 針對上述四個模擬情境中的每一個，第 3 章探討決定哪些服務能在全球斷線中存活的共同依賴：集中的國際閘道（§3.2.1）、衛星與微波備援容量（§3.1.2）、受時間限制的 DNS 與公鑰基礎設施（PKI）更新鏈（§3.3.1–§3.3.3），以及帶有國外路由依賴項的應用層系統（§3.3）。

en.md: ## 2.3 Island Partition

gemini.md: ## 2.3 島內分割

en.md: ### Definition

gemini.md: ### 定義（Definition）

en.md: Island Partition is the worst case on the escalation ladder, because two failures happen together. The north–south domestic long-haul trunks (the main long-distance links inside Taiwan) are cut, so northern Taiwan cannot reach southern Taiwan. At the same time, all global connectivity is lost.

gemini.md: 島內分割是升級階梯中最嚴重的情境，因為兩種失效同時發生。南北向的國內長途幹線（台灣內部主要的長距離連線）中斷，導致北台灣無法連至南台灣；與此同時，對外的全球連線完全中斷。

en.md: Island Partition inherits every effect of Global Cutoff in full. International traffic stops completely, and cache entries of the Domain Name System (DNS) for non-.tw names expire with no way to refresh them. Time-limited protocol data expires as well, and connections fail completely instead of slowing down.

gemini.md: 島內分割完全繼承全球斷線的所有影響。國際流量徹底停擺，非 .tw 網域的網域名稱系統（DNS）快取紀錄陸續過期且無法更新；時限性的協定資料也會過期，連線不再只是變慢，而是徹底失敗。

en.md: The domestic split is added to this global loss. The brownout effects of 50% Degradation (slow, lossy service) are included and exceeded. Each half of the island, north or south, therefore becomes a working network that can reach no other network, domestic or international.

gemini.md: 在全網連外中斷的基礎上，又疊加了島內分割。50% 降載的降質影響（服務變慢且高掉包）不僅已被包含，甚至已被超越。台灣本島的北半部與南半部各自成為運作中卻無法觸及任何其他網路（無論國內或國際）的獨立網路。

en.md: The definition requires both conditions in full: no global access and no north–south link. A partition in which some global access survives falls outside the definition, and the report analyzes that case only as the simulated scenario Partial-Access Partition.

gemini.md: 此定義要求兩項條件同時完全成立：無法連通全球，且南北連線中斷。若分割發生時仍殘留部分全球連線，則不屬於此定義的範圍；本報告僅將該狀況列為模擬情境「部分連外分割」進行分析。

en.md: ### What the failure looks like

gemini.md: ### 失效樣貌（What the failure looks like）

en.md: The domestic network inside each half works as it did before the event. Latency and packet loss are normal, and services hosted in that half are fully reachable. Across the boundary between the halves, the network fails completely: the failure is complete unreachability, not degradation.

gemini.md: 各半部內部的國內網路運作如常。延遲與封包遺失率皆維持正常，託管於該半部內的服務完全可達。但在南北兩半部的邊界線上，網路則徹底失效：這種失效是完全無法觸及，而非服務降質。

en.md: A service in the other half is unreachable by the same mechanism as any foreign-hosted service under Global Cutoff. The connection request (the TCP SYN) gets no reply, and the attempt ends only when the operating system times out. The attempt neither fails quickly nor completes slowly.

gemini.md: 位於另一半部的服務無法觸及，其運作機制與全球斷線下託管於國外的服務完全相同。連線要求（TCP SYN）得不到任何回應，直到作業系統逾時才結束嘗試。這種嘗試既不會快速失敗，也不會緩慢完成。

en.md: The failure across the boundary separates Island Partition from the two lower levels. Under 50% Degradation, cross-island traffic is degraded but not zero, and under Global Cutoff the domestic network is fully operational. Under Island Partition, domestic traffic between the halves is as unreachable as international traffic.

gemini.md: 跨越邊線的失效，將島內分割與較低的兩個梯級區分開來。在 50% 降載下，跨區流量雖降質但並非歸零；在全球斷線下，國內網路仍完全正常運作。但在島內分割下，兩半部之間的國內流量與國際流量一樣無法觸及。

en.md: The closest available real case is below national scale: the routing of occupied Kherson, Ukraine, in 2022–2024 (§2.1, Compromised Transit). In May 2022, Russian forces coerced KhersonTelecom (AS47598) onto upstream providers in Crimea (the networks that carry another network's traffic onward). Kentik then found, in data from route collectors (servers that record the routes that networks announce), that the city was isolated from Ukrainian networks ([Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)). RIPE Labs measured the matching reversal in latency direction ([RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)).

gemini.md: 目前最接近的真實案例屬於國家規模以下：2022 年至 2024 年烏克蘭被佔領區赫爾松的路由情況（§2.1「轉接遭挾持」）。2022 年 5 月，俄羅斯軍隊強迫 KhersonTelecom（AS47598）改經由克里米亞的上游業者（即將其他網路流量繼續往前傳送的網路）。Kentik 隨後從路由收集器（記錄各網路宣告路由的伺服器）的資料中發現，該城市已與烏克蘭網路孤立（[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)）。RIPE Labs 則量測到相對應的延遲方向反轉（[RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)）。

en.md: The Kherson case is similar in structure but is not a direct precedent. The case happened below national scale, and the unoccupied parts of Ukraine kept their global connectivity. No comparable real event documents what Island Partition requires: a partition at island scale combined with a global cutoff at the same time.

gemini.md: 赫爾松案例在結構上相似，但並非直接前例。該事件發生在國家規模以下，且烏克蘭未被佔領的區域仍維持全球連線。目前沒有可比擬的真實事件能夠證明島內分割所需的條件：全島規模的分割同時伴隨全球連線中斷。

en.md: ### Course over time

gemini.md: ### 時間歷程（Course over time）

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition)* The partition appears in routing within minutes of the trunk cuts. Networks announce their routes to each other through the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP). In those minutes, the routes between the two halves (BGP prefixes) are withdrawn or silently dropped (black-holed).

gemini.md: *（依據島內分割定義所做的結構性推論）* 幹線中斷後數分鐘內，路由層面就會顯現分割。各網路透過邊界閘道協定（BGP）彼此宣告路由。在最初的幾分鐘內，兩半部之間的路由（BGP 前綴）會被撤回或遭靜默丟棄（黑洞化）。

en.md: *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* For planning, this report assumes that a partition of Taiwan would take days to settle, a scale comparable to Kherson. Kherson had a city-wide outage on April 30, 2022. On May 1, the first network returned through the Crimean provider. After a further outage on May 30, Kherson's internet service providers (ISPs) lost their links to other Ukrainian networks, "possibly for good". Within a few days, every network in the city was either offline or connected through the Crimean provider ([Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)).

gemini.md: *（依據 2022 年至 2024 年烏克蘭／赫爾松被佔領區路由分析［RIPE Labs 與 Kentik］所做的推論；未經獨立證實）* 出於規劃考量，本報告假設台灣的分割需要數天時間才會穩定，此時間尺度與赫爾松相當。赫爾松於 2022 年 4 月 30 日發生全城網路中斷；5 月 1 日，第一個網路改經由克里米亞的業者恢復連線。在 5 月 30 日發生另一次中斷後，赫爾松的網際網路服務業者（ISP）失去了與烏克蘭其他網路的連線，「可能再也無法恢復」。數天之內，該城市的所有網路要麼離線，要麼透過克里米亞業者連線（[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)）。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Global Cutoff definitions)* In the first phase, from hours to days after onset, the processes of Global Cutoff run in both halves at once. Applications whose servers are in the other half time out as they do under Global Cutoff. DNS cache entries for names in the other half or abroad expire as their time-to-live periods (TTLs) end, with no way to refresh them.

gemini.md: *（依據島內分割與全球斷線定義所做的結構性推論）* 在第一階段（從事件發生後數小時至數天內），全球斷線的演變過程會在南北兩半部同時展開。伺服器位於另一半部的應用程式會像在全球斷線下一樣發生逾時。位於另一半部或國外名稱的 DNS 快取紀錄，會隨著存活時間（TTL）到期而陸續失效，且無法更新。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Global Cutoff definitions)* The protocol clocks (time limits built into protocols) were already counting down: TLS certificate renewal windows, OCSP stapling refresh, and DNSSEC RRSIG validity periods. In this first phase, these clocks approach the delayed failures described under Protocol-Clock Cascade.

gemini.md: *（依據島內分割與全球斷線定義所做的結構性推論）* 協定時鐘（協定內建的時間限制）先前早已開始倒數：TLS 憑證更新時段、OCSP 裝訂刷新，以及 DNSSEC RRSIG 有效期限。在第一階段，這些時鐘會逐漸逼近「協定時鐘連鎖失效」中所描述的延遲性失效。

en.md: *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* In a second phase, a partition maintained by forced rerouting stays exposed to further disruption along the coerced upstream route. Forced rerouting means that an outside party coerces a network onto an upstream provider that the outside party chooses. Kherson's traffic was forced through Crimea in this way. In October 2022, damage to the Kerch Strait Bridge cable then raised latency to networks that depend on UMLC by 5–10 ms, as RIPE Labs documented ([RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)).

gemini.md: *（依據 2022 年至 2024 年烏克蘭／赫爾松被佔領區路由分析［RIPE Labs 與 Kentik］所做的推論；未經獨立證實）* 在第二階段，靠強制繞送維持的分割會持續面臨受挾持上游路徑上的進一步中斷。強制繞送意指外部勢力強迫某個網路使用其指定的上游業者。赫爾松的流量即是以此方式被強迫繞經克里米亞。2022 年 10 月，刻赤海峽大橋海纜受損，導致依賴 UMLC 的網路延遲增加 5 至 10 毫秒，如 RIPE Labs 所記載（[RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)）。

en.md: ### Recognition signatures

gemini.md: ### 辨識特徵（Recognition signatures）

en.md: **BGP and routing plane.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition)* At onset, routes between the halves are withdrawn or black-holed, while routes within each half stay announced and stable. A BGP monitor or route collector inside either half therefore records no withdrawal events. External route collectors see the networks of each half (autonomous systems, identified by AS numbers or ASNs) become unreachable from the other half. This change shows in AS-path data, which lists the networks that each route crosses.

gemini.md: **BGP 與路由平面。** *（依據島內分割定義所做的結構性推論）* 事件發生時，兩半部之間的路由會被撤回或黑洞化，而各半部內部的路由則維持宣告且穩定。因此，位於任一半部內部的 BGP 監測器或路由收集器不會記錄到撤回事件。外部路由收集器則會看到兩半部的網路（自治系統，以 AS 號碼或 ASN 識別）變得無法從另一半部觸及。這項變化會顯現在 AS 路徑資料中，該資料列出了每條路由所跨越的網路。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition and the Kentik Kherson routing documentation cited above)* A partition produced by forced rerouting, not by route withdrawal, changes the AS path detectably. Within days of onset, prefixes from one half are announced through a new upstream AS, as at Kherson (§2.1, Compromised Transit; [Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)). Such a partition therefore has its own routing signature: no withdrawals between the halves, together with a new upstream AS path for one half. Physical connectivity survives but passes through an adversary's upstream, whereas in a partition produced by route withdrawal the paths between the halves disappear from the routing table.

gemini.md: *（依據島內分割定義與前述引用之 Kentik 赫爾松路由文件所做的結構性推論）* 由強制繞送而非路由撤回所造成的分割，會對 AS 路徑產生可偵測的改變。在事件發生數天內，來自其中一半部的前綴會透過新的上游 AS 宣告，如同赫爾松的狀況（§2.1「轉接遭挾持」；[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)）。因此，此類分割具備獨特特徵：兩半部之間沒有撤回訊息，但其中一半部出現了新的上游 AS 路徑。實體連線依然存在，卻改為行經敵對者的上游；相比之下，在路由撤回造成的分割中，兩半部之間的路徑會直接從路由表中消失。

en.md: **Traffic plane.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition)* Within each half, traffic volume and loss rate stay at their pre-event levels. Traffic between the halves is zero, not lossy, and it fails by timeout, as international traffic does under Global Cutoff. RIPE Atlas probes are small measurement devices hosted on volunteers' networks. A probe in the northern half reaches northern services at normal latency and times out on every southern and international destination. A probe in the southern half shows the mirror image.

gemini.md: **流量平面。** *（依據島內分割定義所做的結構性推論）* 在各半部內部，流量與掉包率均維持在事件發生前的水準。兩半部之間的流量則是歸零而非僅是掉包，且會因逾時而失敗，與全球斷線下的國際流量相同。RIPE Atlas 探針是託管於志願者網路上的微型量測設備。位於北半部的探針能以正常延遲觸及北部服務，但對南部及國際的所有目標都會逾時；位於南半部的探針則呈現鏡像狀況。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition)* This two-way split, with normal traffic inside each half, is the definitive sign in the measurements that separates Island Partition from Global Cutoff. Under Global Cutoff, probes anywhere on the island see zero outbound connectivity, while domestic traffic flows across the whole island.

gemini.md: *（依據島內分割定義所做的結構性推論）* 這種雙向分割且各半部內部流量正常的現象，是量測中將島內分割與全球斷線區分開來的決定性特徵。在全球斷線下，全島任何位置的探針都會看到對外連線歸零，但國內流量依然涵蓋全島。

en.md: *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* Aggregate traffic on Cloudflare Radar (Cloudflare's public traffic dashboard) cannot separate the two levels alone. Both halves have lost global access, so the aggregate under Island Partition itself falls to near zero, much like the sudden drop under Global Cutoff. Separating the two levels on Cloudflare Radar requires city-level data. In that data, some cities show domestic traffic at pre-event levels alongside zero international traffic. This pattern is absent under Global Cutoff, where all cities show near-zero outbound traffic.

gemini.md: *（依據 2022 年至 2024 年烏克蘭／赫爾松被佔領區路由分析［RIPE Labs 與 Kentik］所做的推論；未經獨立證實）* 單靠 Cloudflare Radar（Cloudflare 的公開流量儀表板）上的總流量資料無法區分這兩個梯級。由於兩半部皆已失去全球存取能力，島內分割本身下的總流量會降至接近零，與全球斷線下的驟降極為相似。要在 Cloudflare Radar 上區分這兩個梯級，需要城市層級的資料。在該資料中，某些城市會顯示國內流量維持在事件前水準，同時國際流量為零。這種模式在全球斷線下並不存在，全球斷線時所有城市都會顯示對外流量接近零。

en.md: **DNS and cache behavior.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Global Cutoff definitions)* Within each half, names hosted abroad or in the other half resolve as they do under Global Cutoff. Cache entries expire as their TTLs end, with no way to refresh them. A resolver returns SERVFAIL (the response code for a lookup that it cannot complete) for any name whose authoritative server is off the island or in the other half. An authoritative server holds the official records of a name.

gemini.md: **DNS 與快取行為。** *（依據島內分割與全球斷線定義所做的結構性推論）* 在各半部內部，託管於國外或另一半部的網域名稱解析方式與全球斷線下相同。快取紀錄隨著 TTL 到期而失效且無法更新。對於權威伺服器位於島外或另一半部的任何網域名稱，解析器都會傳回 SERVFAIL（無法完成查詢的回應碼）。權威伺服器保存著網域名稱的官方紀錄。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition)* A .tw zone whose primary authoritative nameservers are in the other half depends on secondary nameservers in the user's own half. These secondary nameservers are the only mechanism that prevents split-brain SERVFAIL, a lookup failure caused by the split between the halves. Without them, the connectivity failure becomes a name-resolution failure for users in that half. The name-resolution failure occurs even when the domain's web servers are in that half and operational.

gemini.md: *（依據島內分割定義所做的結構性推論）* 若某個 .tw 區域的主要權威名稱伺服器位於另一半部，則必須依賴使用者所在半部的次要名稱伺服器。這些次要名稱伺服器是防止「腦裂 SERVFAIL」（因兩半部切割所導致的查詢失敗）的唯一機制。若缺乏這些伺服器，對該半部的使用者而言，連線失效就會演變為名稱解析失敗。即便該網域的 Web 伺服器位於該半部且正常運作，名稱解析失敗依然會發生。

en.md: **Recovery path.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition)* Recovery requires two failures to be resolved independently. The cut trunks follow the timeline of a physical engineering repair. The loss of global connectivity follows the timeline of a cable repair or of an administrative reversal. Neither repair resolves the other, so restoration takes at least as long as the longer timeline. The two independent repairs give Island Partition the compound worst-case recovery on the escalation ladder.

gemini.md: **復原路徑。** *（依據島內分割定義所做的結構性推論）* 復原需要獨立解決兩種失效。中斷的幹線取決於實體工程修復的時間軸；全球連線的中斷則取決於海纜修復或行政決策逆轉的時間軸。兩種修復互不影響，因此復原所需時間至少與較長的時間軸相當。這兩種獨立的修復使島內分割成為升級階梯中最複雜且最嚴重的復原狀況。

en.md: *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* Where forced rerouting maintains the partition, restoring the pre-partition path requires removing the outside coercion. Removing the coercion is a political or military event, not a cable splice. RIPE Labs reported that latency at Kherson returned to pre-partition levels "pretty quickly" once liberation on November 11, 2022 removed the coercion. This return of latency is consistent with routing going back to its pre-partition paths as soon as the AS-path coercion ended ([RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)).

gemini.md: *（依據 2022 年至 2024 年烏克蘭／赫爾松被佔領區路由分析［RIPE Labs 與 Kentik］所做的推論；未經獨立證實）* 在靠強制繞送維持分割的情況下，要恢復分割前的路徑，必須先解除外部脅迫。解除脅迫屬於政治或軍事事件，而非接續海纜即可解決。RIPE Labs 報導指出，當 2022 年 11 月 11 日收復赫爾松並解除脅迫後，赫爾松的延遲「相當迅速」地恢復到分割前的水準。延遲的回升與 AS 路徑脅迫一結束路由即恢復至分割前路徑的狀況吻合（[RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)）。

en.md: **Telling the simulated scenarios apart.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Partial-Access Partition definitions)* Partial-Access Partition differs from Island Partition itself in traffic volume and in its geographic distribution. Island Partition itself shows near-zero aggregate traffic from both halves on Cloudflare Radar and in the active probing of IODA (the Internet Outage Detection and Analysis project). Partial-Access Partition shows a drop to a lower level, not a fall to near zero, and residual traffic from one half makes city-level data geographically uneven.

gemini.md: **區分各模擬情境。** *（依據島內分割與部分連外分割定義所做的結構性推論）* 「部分連外分割」與島內分割本身的差異在於流量與地理分布。在 Cloudflare Radar 以及 IODA（網際網路中斷偵測與分析專案）的主動探測中，島內分割本身顯示兩半部的總流量皆接近零。「部分連外分割」則顯示流量降至較低水準而非接近零，且來自其中一半部的殘餘流量會使城市層級的資料呈現地理上的不平均。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Single-City Isolation definitions)* Single-City Isolation differs in the geographic scope of the traffic failure. Under Island Partition itself, RIPE Atlas probes anywhere in either half reach nothing in the other half and nothing abroad. Under Single-City Isolation, probes outside the isolated city show no partition anomaly, and a probe inside the city reaches no destination outside the city.

gemini.md: *（依據島內分割與單城孤立定義所做的結構性推論）* 「單城孤立」的差異在於流量失效的地理範圍。在島內分割本身之下，位於任一半部任何位置的 RIPE Atlas 探針都無法觸及另一半部或國外的任何目標。在單城孤立下，被孤立城市外部的探針不會顯示任何分割異常，而城市內部的探針則無法觸及該城市以外的任何目標。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Site-Level Blackout definitions)* Site-Level Blackout produces no BGP signal and requires no island-wide routing event. A site with no upstream connectivity takes no part in the routing table. In measurements, the site cannot be told apart from a network segment that is switched off, and the site shows no split in reachability. The site's absence from the responses to active probing is therefore the only sign visible from outside.

gemini.md: *（依據島內分割與站點全斷定義所做的結構性推論）* 「站點全斷」不會產生任何 BGP 訊號，也不需要全島規模的路由事件。沒有上游連線的站點不會參與路由表。在量測上，無法將該站點與已關閉的網路區段區分開來，且該站點不會顯示可達性的切割現象。因此，主動探測回應中缺乏該站點的資料，是從外部唯一能觀察到的跡象。

gemini.md: ### 模擬情境（Simulated scenarios）

en.md: #### Partial-Access Partition

gemini.md: #### Partial-Access Partition

en.md: A simulated scenario under Island Partition: the north–south domestic trunks are cut and most global connectivity is lost. One half keeps a surviving international cable path, which gives limited global access to that half only. The other half has none.

gemini.md: 島內分割下的模擬情境：南北向國內幹線中斷，且大部分對外全球連線喪失。其中一半部保留了倖存的國際海纜路徑，僅為該半部提供有限的全球存取能力；另一半部則完全沒有。

en.md: **What happens.** The two halves fail unevenly. The half with no surviving cable follows Island Partition itself: it reaches neither the other half nor the rest of the world. In the other half, a cable landing station (the site where a submarine cable comes ashore) survives in one geographic cluster, such as the southern cluster at Fangshan (枋山). The surviving station provides a small amount of global bandwidth.

gemini.md: **事件經過。** 南北兩半部的失效並不對等。無倖存海纜的半部演變情況與島內分割本身相同：既無法觸及另一半部，也無法觸及世界其他地方。在另一半部，海纜登陸站（海纜上陸的地點）在某個地理群聚中倖存，例如位於枋山的南部群聚。倖存的登陸站提供了少量的全球頻寬。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the k1, k2, and k3 gateway-kind descriptions in §3.2.1 and the Island Partition definition)* Whether that bandwidth is usable depends on the international gateway that serves the surviving cable. The table gives the result for each failure kind of that gateway:

gemini.md: *（依據 §3.2.1 中 k1、k2 與 k3 閘道類型說明及島內分割定義所做的結構性推論）* 該頻寬是否可用，取決於服務該倖存海纜的國際閘道。下表列出該閘道在每種失效類型下的結果：

en.md:
| Gateway kind (§3.2.1) | Global access of the half that keeps a cable |
|---|---|
| k1, administrative shutdown | None in practice. The gateway blocks all outbound traffic, whatever physical path it arrives on. The physical survival of the cable therefore makes no practical difference |
| k2, throughput ceiling | Like a brownout. An administrative throttle on general civilian traffic leaves the surviving half's international access closer to what 50% Degradation looks like. The other half has no global access |
| k3, forced rerouting | Traffic flows, but it passes through adversary-controlled infrastructure. This exposes the half's international communications to content inspection and forced path selection |

gemini.md:
| 閘道類型（§3.2.1） | 保留海纜半部的全球存取能力 |
|---|---|
| k1，行政關閉 | 實際上完全沒有。無論對外流量經由何種實體路徑到達，閘道均予以封鎖。因此，海纜在實體上的倖存實際上毫無影響 |
| k2，傳輸量上限 | 類似降質。對一般民用流量進行行政限速，使倖存半部的國際存取能力較接近 50% 降載的狀況。另一半部則無全球存取能力 |
| k3，強制繞送 | 流量可通暢傳送，但會行經敵對者控制的基礎設施。這使該半部的國際通訊面臨內容檢查與強制路徑選擇的風險 |

en.md: Under every gateway kind, domestic traffic between the halves stays unreachable. The cut north–south trunks are the defining failure of Island Partition, and they carry no traffic whatever the gateway policy.

gemini.md: 在每一種閘道類型下，兩半部之間的國內流量始終無法觸及。南北幹線中斷是島內分割的核心特徵失效，無論閘道政策為何，幹線均不傳送任何流量。

en.md: **Precedent.** *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* The Kherson case documents uneven access below national scale. The city received limited connectivity through Crimea, while unoccupied Ukrainian regions kept their own international paths. Two geographically distinct areas with different upstream providers therefore operated at the same time. Two sources document how the routing paths and the latency direction of the two areas differed: [Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/) and [RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/).

gemini.md: **前例。** *（依據 2022 年至 2024 年烏克蘭／赫爾松被佔領區路由分析［RIPE Labs 與 Kentik］所做的推論；未經獨立證實）* 赫爾松案例記載了國家規模以下的非對等存取。該城市透過克里米亞獲得有限的連線，而未被佔領的烏克蘭區域則保留了各自的國際路徑。因此，兩個使用不同上游業者的地理獨立區域同時運作。兩份來源記錄了這兩個區域在路由路徑與延遲方向上的差異：[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/) 與 [RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)。

en.md: *(Inference from the dComms roundtable, June 2026; not independently confirmed)* The dComms roundtable identified the gateway failure kind (k1, k2, or k3) as what determines whether a surviving physical cable gives usable global access.

gemini.md: *（依據 2026 年 6 月 dComms 圓桌會議所做的推論；未經獨立證實）* dComms 圓桌會議指出，閘道失效類型（k1、k2 或 k3）是決定倖存的實體海纜能否提供可用全球存取的關鍵。

en.md: **Applies to Taiwan:** partly. The Kherson case is a comparable event of uneven access, but the scale differs: Kherson was below national scale, and this scenario covers the whole island. Taiwan's southern landing stations at Fangshan (枋山) are geographically separated from the northern stations. The physical survival of one station cluster without the other is therefore plausible under the physical triggers that produce Island Partition.

gemini.md: **對台灣的適用程度：**部分適用。赫爾松案例是可比擬的非對等存取事件，但規模不同：赫爾松屬於國家規模以下，而此情境涵蓋全島。台灣位於枋山的南部登陸站與北部登陸站在地理上相隔甚遠。因此在產生島內分割的實體觸發因素下，其中一個登陸站群聚倖存而另一個毀損，在結構上是合理的。

en.md: **How to tell it from Single-City Isolation.** *(Structural inference from the Partial-Access Partition and Single-City Isolation definitions)* The difference is geographic scope. Partial-Access Partition cuts the north–south trunks across the whole island and leaves the halves with unequal international access. Single-City Isolation cuts all the upstream links of one municipality, while the domestic network in the rest of each half stays intact.

gemini.md: **如何與「單城孤立」區分。** *（依據部分連外分割與單城孤立定義所做的結構性推論）* 差異在於地理範圍。「部分連外分割」切斷了全島的南北幹線，並使兩半部擁有非對等的國際存取能力；「單城孤立」則切斷了單一直轄市或市的所有上游連線，而兩半部其餘區域的國內網路仍保持完好。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise for this scenario would change the surviving half's gateway failure kind from run to run (k1 shut down by administrative order, k2 throttled, k3 watched by an adversary, or open) and ask cross-functional teams, with no network information beyond the scenario, which services and communication paths survive under each gateway condition.

gemini.md: **演練備註。** 針對此情境的桌上推演，會在每次演練中變更倖存半部的閘道失效類型（k1 行政命令關閉、k2 被限速、k3 受敵對者監控，或正常開放），並在不提供情境以外網路資訊的情況下，詢問跨領域團隊在每種閘道狀況下有哪些服務與通訊路徑能夠倖存。

en.md: #### Single-City Isolation

gemini.md: #### Single-City Isolation

en.md: A simulated scenario under Island Partition: one city (a municipality or urban area) loses all its upstream links to the rest of the island's domestic network at once. The wider island network keeps operating within each half of the partition.

gemini.md: 島內分割下的模擬情境：單一城市（直轄市、市或都會區）同時失去了連接全島其他國內網路的所有上游連線。全島更廣泛的網路則繼續在分割後的各半部內部運作。

en.md: **What happens.** A single physical event cuts every upstream link into the city. The event is a trunk failure along a geographic corridor, or cable damage at a bridge or mountain pass. The event can also be the simultaneous loss of all the last-mile aggregation points that feed the city (the sites where the final links to users join the wider network). Elsewhere in each half, the domestic network keeps operating normally.

gemini.md: **事件經過。** 單一實體事件切斷了進入該城市的所有上游連線。此事件可能是沿著某條地理走廊的幹線中斷，或是橋樑、隘口處的光纜受損；也可以是向該城市供給網路的所有最後一哩彙整點（使用者最終連線接入更廣泛網路的站點）同時失效。在各半部的其他地方，國內網路仍保持正常運作。

en.md: From inside the city, every service hosted outside the city is unreachable, including services on the rest of the island. The north–south partition already divides those services, and the failure of the city's own upstream links now removes them entirely. The unreachable services also include international services, which the concurrent Global Cutoff already removes.

gemini.md: 從城市內部來看，託管於該城市外部的每一項服務均無法觸及，包括本島其他地方的服務。南北分割先前早已將這些服務切割開來，而該城市自身上游連線的失效則將其徹底抹去。無法觸及的服務也包含國際服務，而同時發生的全球斷線先前早已將其抹去。

en.md: Services hosted inside the city still serve local users over the city's internal network, so emergency responders in the city can reach only local resources. Coordination systems, databases and communication paths hosted anywhere outside the city are as unreachable as foreign ones.

gemini.md: 託管於城市內部的服務仍可透過城市內部網路為在地使用者提供服務，因此城內的應變人員僅能存取在地資源。託管於城市外部任何地方的協調系統、資料庫與通訊路徑，均與國外資源一樣無法觸及。

en.md: **Precedent.** *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* The Kherson case documents routing isolation at city scale. All of the city's internet access was rerouted through a single non-Ukrainian upstream, and the rerouting made the city a routing zone disconnected from the Ukrainian domestic network. Kentik documents the BGP path change that produced this isolation ([Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)).

gemini.md: **前例。** *（依據 2022 年至 2024 年烏克蘭／赫爾松被佔領區路由分析［RIPE Labs 與 Kentik］所做的推論；未經獨立證實）* 赫爾松案例記載了城市規模的路由孤立。該城市所有的網際網路存取皆被繞送至單一非烏克蘭上游，這次繞送使該城市成為與烏克蘭國內網路斷開的路由區域。Kentik 記錄了造成此孤立狀況的 BGP 路徑變更（[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)）。

en.md: *(Inference from the dComms roundtable, June 2026; not independently confirmed)* The dComms roundtable identified Single-City Isolation as a scenario relevant to drills. The drills are for civil-society and private-sector engineers who reason about how local services survive without coordination from outside the city.

gemini.md: *（依據 2026 年 6 月 dComms 圓桌會議所做的推論；未經獨立證實）* dComms 圓桌會議指出「單城孤立」是與演練相關的情境。這些演練物件為公民社會與民間企業工程師，旨在思考在地服務如何在缺乏城市外部協調的情況下倖存。

en.md: **Applies to Taiwan:** partly. The Kherson case is a comparable event at city scale, but the conditions differ: Kherson was isolated by forced rerouting, and this scenario by a physical cut. The scenario requires only the simultaneous cutting of a city's upstream long-haul fiber routes, which typically enter through a small number of trunk corridors and terrain chokepoints. Such a cut is structurally plausible under the physical triggers that produce Island Partition.

gemini.md: **對台灣的適用程度：**部分適用。赫爾松案例是城市規模的可比擬事件，但條件不同：赫爾松因強制繞送而遭孤立，此情境則因實體切斷所致。該情境僅需要同時切斷城市的上游長途光纜路徑，而這些路徑通常經由少數幹線走廊與地形瓶頸點進入。在產生島內分割的實體觸發因素下，此類切斷在結構上是合理的。

en.md: **How to tell it from Partial-Access Partition.** *(Structural inference from the Partial-Access Partition and Single-City Isolation definitions)* The difference is the extent of the domestic failure: Single-City Isolation does not require island-wide cutting of the north–south trunks. Single-City Isolation can occur while domestic connectivity is intact in every non-isolated part of each half, so its failure is confined to one municipality.

gemini.md: **如何與「部分連外分割」區分。** *（依據部分連外分割與單城孤立定義所做的結構性推論）* 差異在於國內失效的程度：「單城孤立」不需要全島規模的南北幹線切斷。單城孤立可以在各半部未被孤立的其他區域國內連線皆完好的情況下發生，因此其失效僅限於單一直轄市或市。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise for this scenario would limit participants to the resources and communication paths physically inside one city and ask teams which locally hosted services, local coordination mechanisms and local human and organizational channels still work when network access outside the city is zero.

gemini.md: **演練備註。** 針對此情境的桌上推演，會將參與者限制於實體位於單一城市內部的資源與通訊路徑上，並詢問團隊當城市外部的網路存取歸零時，有哪些在地託管的服務、在地協調機制以及在地的公民與組織管道仍可運作。

en.md: #### Site-Level Blackout

gemini.md: #### Site-Level Blackout

en.md: A simulated scenario under Island Partition: a single rescue, shelter or critical-infrastructure site has no upstream connectivity at all, because its last-mile links are completely cut. The site becomes an isolated on-site network with no path to any external node on the domestic network or the global internet.

gemini.md: 島內分割下的模擬情境：單一救援、避難所或關鍵基礎設施站點因最後一哩連線完全中斷，導致完全缺乏上游連線。該站點成為一個孤立的現場區域網路，無法連接至國內網路或全球網際網路上的任何外部節點。

en.md: **What happens.** The site's last-mile connections to all its upstream providers are cut at once. The cause is cut fiber, destroyed antenna installations, or loss of the power supply that sustains its radio links. The site's internal network keeps operating: devices reach each other, and locally hosted services and locally cached data stay accessible. No packet crosses the site boundary in either direction.

gemini.md: **事件經過。** 該站點連接至所有上游业者的最後一哩連線同時中斷。原因包括光纜遭切斷、天線設施毀損，或是維持無線電連線的電源中斷。站點的內部網路維持運作：裝置之間可互相連通，且在地託管的服務與在地快取的資料依然可存取。封包無法雙向跨越站點邊界。

en.md: Every digital resource that the site depended on but did not host is unreachable. Examples are patient records, authorization systems, real-time operational data and software updates. Staff cannot reach emergency coordination systems hosted elsewhere, verify instructions from outside authorities, send status reports, or reach any live data source outside the site. The site's only working network resources are those that were present and operational on site before the last-mile link failed.

gemini.md: 該站點所依賴但未自行託管的每一項數位資源均無法觸及。例如病歷紀錄、授權系統、即時運作資料與軟體更新。工作人員無法存取託管於其他地方的緊急協調系統、無法驗證外部主管機關的指示、無法發送狀態報告，也無法存取站點外部的任何即時資料源。該站點唯一能運作的網路資源，僅有在最後一哩連線失效前就已存在於現場且正常運作的資源。

en.md: **Precedent.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition definition and the site-connectivity premise of the simulated scenario)* Site-Level Blackout follows from the definition of Island Partition: the partition and the global cutoff together cut every path out of each half. A site whose last-mile links are also cut then has no path to any external node, by construction.

gemini.md: **前例。** *（依據島內分割定義與該模擬情境之站點連線前提所做的結構性推論）* 「站點全斷」推導自島內分割的定義：分割與全球斷線共同切斷了離開各半部的所有路徑。當某個站點的最後一哩連線亦遭切斷時，依結構推導，該站點便無任何通往外部節點的路徑。

en.md: No primary source documents an event at exactly this scale. That scale is a single rescue or shelter site with its last-mile links completely cut while Island Partition is in effect at the same time. The precedent therefore rests on mechanism, not on an incident.

gemini.md: 沒有一手來源記載過完全屬於此規模的事件。該規模是指在島內分割同時生效的情況下，單一救援或避難站點的最後一哩連線完全中斷。因此，前例係建立在機制上，而非單一事件上。

en.md: The war in Ukraine offers a partial illustration at a comparable scale. Individual Starlink terminals (satellite internet terminals) were the only connectivity path for some frontline sites. The loss or suppression of those terminals left those sites with no electronic communication path to any outside node ([Cloudflare Blog, One Year of War in Ukraine, February 2023](https://blog.cloudflare.com/one-year-of-war-in-ukraine/)).

gemini.md: 烏克蘭戰爭提供了可比擬規模的局部說明。個別的星鏈（Starlink）終端機（衛星網際網路終端機）是某些前線站點唯一的連線路徑。這些終端機的毀損或遭壓制，使這些站點失去與任何外部節點連線的電子通訊路徑（[Cloudflare Blog, One Year of War in Ukraine, February 2023](https://blog.cloudflare.com/one-year-of-war-in-ukraine/)）。

en.md: **Applies to Taiwan:** directly. Any critical site in Taiwan that depends on a single last-mile connection path is susceptible to this pattern under the physical conditions that produce Island Partition.

gemini.md: **對台灣的適用程度：**直接適用。在產生島內分割的實體條件下，台灣任何依賴單一最後一哩連線路徑的關鍵站點，皆容易面臨此模式。

en.md: **How to tell it from Single-City Isolation.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition and Site-Level Blackout definitions)* The difference lies in BGP and routing. Single-City Isolation produces a routing event on the city's upstream AS paths, which route-collector data shows. Single-City Isolation also produces zero reachability from inside the city's address space, which probes show. Site-Level Blackout produces neither, because a site with no upstream connectivity takes no part in the routing table.

gemini.md: **如何與「單城孤立」區分。** *（依據島內分割與站點全斷定義所做的結構性推論）* 差異在於 BGP 與路由。「單城孤立」會在城市的上游 AS 路徑上產生路由事件，該事件可由路由收集器資料顯示；單城孤立也會從城市位址空間內部產生零可達性，該狀況可由探針顯示。「站點全斷」則兩者皆不會產生，因為缺乏上游連線的站點不會參與路由表。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise for this scenario would give responders only locally cached data and local communication paths, with no outside network access, and ask which operational decisions they can make from local resources alone, which need outside coordination they cannot reach, and which resources would have to be on site before the last-mile link failed.

gemini.md: **演練備註。** 針對此情境的桌上推演，會僅向應變人員提供在地快取的資料與在地通訊路徑，不提供任何外部網路存取，並詢問其僅憑在地資源能做出哪些維運決策、哪些決策需要無法觸及的外部協調，以及哪些資源必須在最後一哩連線失效前就已置於現場。

en.md: ### In Chapter 3

gemini.md: ### 第 3 章對應內容（In Chapter 3）

en.md: Chapter 3 traces each shared dependency at the Island Partition level, in all three simulated scenarios listed here (Partial-Access Partition, Single-City Isolation and Site-Level Blackout): submarine cables (§3.1.1), the international gateway (§3.2.1), domestic peering (§3.2.3), DNS resolution (§3.3.1), TLS/PKI and trust (§3.3.2), push fan-out (§3.3.4), identity and access (§3.3.5), and every other shared dependency in §§3.1–3.3.

gemini.md: 第 3 章探討了在島內分割梯級下，此處列出的所有三個模擬情境（部分連外分割、單城孤立與站點全斷）中的每一項共同依賴：海纜（§3.1.1）、國際閘道（§3.2.1）、國內對等互連（§3.2.3）、DNS 解析（§3.3.1）、TLS/PKI 與信任（§3.3.2）、推播擴散（§3.3.4）、身分與存取（§3.3.5），以及 §§3.1–3.3 中的每一項其他共同依賴。

The report discusses Threat contexts in Chapter 1, the Background chapter, only.

gemini.md: 第 1 章透過威脅背景連結至本章。本報告將威脅背景定義為地緣政治或天然災害條件：平時事故、封鎖（遭包圍）、解放軍（PLA）登陸或超級大地震。本報告僅在第 1 章（背景章節）討論威脅背景。

en.md: The report treats Threat contexts as causally separate from the disruption levels: any Threat context might produce any disruption level, or none.
